  .netra-setup select {
    width: 100%;
    background: #171126;
    color: #f0eaff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(155, 114, 203, 0.45);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 7px 8px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }
  .netra-setup input[type=range] { width: 100%; accent-color: #9b72cb; }
  .netra-setup-meter {
    height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); margin-top: 6px;
  }
  .netra-setup-meter i {
    display: block; height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #34e08f, #4285F4);
    transition: width 0.12s linear;
  }
  .netra-setup-btn {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 9px 10px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(155, 114, 203, 0.5);
    background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.22);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .netra-setup-btn:hover { background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.38); }
  .netra-setup-ghost { background: transparent; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: #cfc4e8; }
  .netra-setup-check {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 12px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #d9d0f0; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .netra-setup-check input { accent-color: #8b3df0; width: 15px; height: 15px; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .netra-setup { left: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); }
    .netra-setup-body { width: 210px; }
  }
  /* R23 - phones: the tab sits under the header, the panel opens as a
     bottom sheet over the stage and scrolls on its own */
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .netra-stage .netra-setup { top: calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); left: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); transform: none; max-height: none; }
    .netra-stage .netra-setup-body {
      position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: auto;
      max-height: 76vh; max-height: 76dvh;
      border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
      padding: 16px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)) calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
      background: rgba(18, 16, 26, 0.97);
      box-shadow: 0 -14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
      z-index: 90;
    }
    .netra-stage .netra-setup select, .netra-stage .netra-setup-btn { min-height: 44px; font-size: 15px; }
    /* the Lab: a sheet across the width, above the round controls so they
       stay reachable, scrolling on its own. Up to 600 px the controls sit
       46 px up: 46 + 62 px buttons + 6 px focus ring = 114 */
    .netra-stage .netra-lab {
      top: auto; width: auto; max-width: none;
      left: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
      right: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
      bottom: calc(116px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
      max-height: calc(100vh - 236px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
      max-height: calc(100dvh - 236px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
      overflow-x: hidden;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 0 12px 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
      animation: none;
    }
  }
  /* 480 px and less: the controls sit 30 px up, 30 + 62 + 6 = 98 */
  @media (max-width: 480px) {
    .netra-stage .netra-lab {
      bottom: calc(104px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
      max-height: calc(100vh - 224px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
      max-height: calc(100dvh - 224px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    }
  }
  /* a phone held sideways: the Lab stops above the round controls */
  @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) {
    .netra-stage .netra-lab { top: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); max-height: calc(100vh - 150px); }
  }
  /* touch screens: a checkbox big enough to hit */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .netra-setup-check input { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  }

  /* R9 - interactive calibration card */
  .netra-calib-card {
    max-width: 560px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: rgba(16, 12, 26, 0.78);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2);
    border: 1px solid var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.3));
    box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 30px var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.15));
    padding: 14px 18px 12px;
    text-align: center;
    animation: netra-lab-in 0.3s ease;
  }
  .netra-calib-title {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    color: var(--iris-bright, #b9a8ee);
    display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline;
  }
  .netra-calib-stage { color: #8f83b5; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: none; font-weight: 500; }
  .netra-calib-sentence { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #ffffff; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
  .netra-calib-live { font-size: 13px; color: #cdbff0; font-style: italic; min-height: 20px; margin-top: 6px; }
  .netra-calib-dot {
    display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--iris-bright, #7fffb0); margin-right: 8px;
    animation: netra-halo-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .netra-calib-result { margin: 8px 0 2px; display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: baseline; }
  .netra-calib-score { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--iris-bright, #7fffb0); }
  .netra-calib-verdict { font-size: 13px; color: #d9d0f0; }
  .netra-calib-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 10px; }
  .netra-calib-actions button {
    background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.18);
    border: 1px solid var(--netra-glow-soft, rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.45));
    color: #e4dbff; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px;
    padding: 5px 16px; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .netra-calib-actions button:hover { background: rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.34); }

  /* keyboard focus on the blob: a white ring with a dark halo, visible on
     the dark room and the pastel mesh alike, and in 3D mode too (the
     3D rule above drops the blob's drop-shadow glow) */
  .netra-stage .netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus-visible,
  .netra-stage.netra-3d-on .netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid #ffffff !important;
    outline-offset: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(8, 6, 14, 0.85);
  }
  /* on the near-black Gemini stage a thinner Gemini-blue ring is plenty
     (#8ab4f8 is 9:1 against it) and frames the orb instead of boxing it */
  .netra-stage.netra-3d-on .netra-stage-blob-wrap:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #8ab4f8 !important;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  /* a phone held sideways: a short caption instead of none */
  @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) {
    .netra-stage .netra-stage-caption {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      max-width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px));
      max-height: 22vh;
    }
  }
  /* reduced motion: the room holds still - no drifting mesh, spinning
     rings, pulsing dots or sliding panels (stage3d.js honours it too) */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .netra-stage *, .netra-stage *::before, .netra-stage *::after {
      animation: none !important;
      transition: none !important;
    }
    .netra-stage .netra-ripple { display: none; }
  }
</style>
<div class="netra-root"
     ng-class="['netra-state-' + c.state, {'netra-barged': c.bargeFlash}]"
     role="region"
     aria-label="Netra voice assistant">

  <!-- SR live regions. R24 - on the Live stage its own status line (or the
       loading card's) announces the state, so this one is off there: one
       state, said once -->
  <div class="netra-sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" ng-if="!c.liveMode">
    {{c.stateLabel}}
  </div>
  <div class="netra-sr-only" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" aria-atomic="true">
    {{c.spoken}}
  </div>

  <!-- ====================================================
        DEV PANEL  (visible when c.devOn === true)
        ==================================================== -->
  <div class="netra-dev" ng-show="c.devOn" aria-hidden="true">
    <header class="netra-dev-head" ng-mousedown="c.devDragStart($event)" title="Drag this bar to move the developer console">
      <span class="netra-dev-brand" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg class="netra-dev-glyph" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
          <defs>
            <!-- R8.1 - the mini-eye follows the live prism hue via CSS classes -->
            <radialGradient id="ndg-iris" cx="38%" cy="34%" r="66%">
              <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#eafff2"/><stop offset="20%" class="ndgi-1" stop-color="#7fffb0"/>
              <stop offset="58%" class="ndgi-2" stop-color="#2eb858"/><stop offset="100%" class="ndgi-3" stop-color="#021a0d"/>
            </radialGradient>
            <linearGradient id="ndg-ring" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#37e6a8"/><stop offset="30%" stop-color="#41c6ff"/>
              <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#c660ff"/><stop offset="78%" stop-color="#ffb84d"/>
              <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff5f9e"/>
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <g fill="none" stroke="url(#ndg-ring)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" ng-class="{'netra-dev-glyph-live': c.recRunning}">
            <path d="M4 16 A12 12 0 0 1 16 4"/><path d="M28 16 A12 12 0 0 1 16 28"/>
          </g>
          <path d="M6 16 Q16 7 26 16 Q16 25 6 16 Z" fill="#0a0614" stroke="#d8c8ff" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="6" fill="url(#ndg-iris)"/>
          <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="2.4" fill="#001a0a"/>
          <circle cx="14.2" cy="14.2" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity="0.9"/>
        </svg>
        <span class="netra-dev-word">NETRA</span>
        <span class="netra-dev-badge-vr">R8.1 · PRISM</span>
        <span class="netra-dev-badge-fc" title="Netra has full create / edit / modify capability on every ticket type. Admin kill-switch: set ticket_writes to false.">TICKETS: FULL CONTROL</span>
      </span>
      <span class="netra-dev-live" ng-class="{'on': c.recRunning}" title="Recognition {{c.recRunning ? 'running' : 'stopped'}}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span class="netra-dev-pill netra-dev-pill-{{c.state}}">{{c.state}}</span>
      <span class="netra-dev-pill netra-dev-pill-mode"
            ng-class="{'on': c.alert, 'off': !c.alert}">{{c.alert ? 'AWAKE' : 'ASLEEP'}}</span>
      <button class="netra-dev-x" ng-click="c.toggleDev()" title="Hide (Alt+D)">hide</button>
    </header>

    <!-- R2.12 - VS Code-style tab bar (R7 adds Chat) -->
    <nav class="netra-dev-tabs" role="tablist">
      <span class="netra-dev-tab" ng-class="{'active': c.devTab === 'voice'}"
            ng-click="c.devSetTab('voice')" role="tab">Voice</span>
      <span class="netra-dev-tab" ng-class="{'active': c.devTab === 'chat'}"
            ng-click="c.devSetTab('chat')" role="tab">Chat</span>
      <span class="netra-dev-tab" ng-class="{'active': c.devTab === 'monitor'}"
            ng-click="c.devSetTab('monitor')" role="tab">Monitor</span>
      <span class="netra-dev-tab" ng-class="{'active': c.devTab === 'logs'}"
            ng-click="c.devSetTab('logs')" role="tab">Logs</span>
      <span class="netra-dev-tab" ng-class="{'active': c.devTab === 'training'}"
            ng-click="c.devSetTab('training')" role="tab">Training</span>
    </nav>

    <div class="netra-dev-body">
    <!-- R1.2 - LIVE MIC LEVEL METER (visual confirmation audio is reaching the browser) -->
    <section class="netra-mic-meter" ng-show="c.devTab === 'voice' || c.devTab === 'monitor'">
      <div class="netra-mic-meter-label">
        MIC LEVEL
        <span class="netra-mic-meter-status" ng-class="{'l-err': !c.micStreamActive, 'on': c.micStreamActive}">{{c.micStreamActive ? 'LIVE' : 'no stream'}}</span>
        <span class="netra-mic-meter-peak">peak {{c.micLevelPeak || 0}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-mic-meter-track">
        <div class="netra-mic-meter-fill" ng-style="{width: (c.micLevel || 0) + '%'}"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-mic-meter-test">
        <button ng-click="c.devTestMic()" ng-disabled="c.micRecording || !c.micStreamActive">Test Mic (3s record + playback)</button>
        <em ng-show="c.micTestResult">{{c.micTestResult}}</em>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-status" ng-show="c.devTab === 'monitor'">
      <div><span>state</span><b>{{c.stateLabel}}</b></div>
      <div><span>recognition</span><b ng-class="{'l-err': !c.recRunning}">{{c.recRunning ? 'RUNNING (always-on)' : 'stopped'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>mode</span><b ng-class="{'on': c.conversationOpen}">{{c.conversationOpen ? 'ALWAYS LISTENING - just speak' : 'closed (say "Netra" or "wake up")'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>TTS engine</span><b>{{c.ttsEngine === 'edge' ? ('Microsoft Edge ' + c.edgeVoice) : c.ttsEngine === 'gemini' ? ('Gemini Native ' + c.geminiVoice) : c.ttsEngine === 'stream' ? ('StreamElements ' + c.remoteVoice) : ('browser ' + c.voiceName)}}</b></div>
      <div><span>mic permission</span><b ng-class="{'l-err': c.permission==='denied'}">{{c.permission}}</b></div>
      <div><span>API key</span><b ng-class="{'l-err': !c.data.has_api_key}">{{c.data.has_api_key ? 'set' : 'MISSING'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>confidence</span><b>{{c.confidence || '-'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>uptime</span><b>{{c.stats.uptimeLabel || '-'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>utterances</span><b>{{c.stats.utterances || 0}}</b></div>
      <div><span>tools called</span><b>{{c.stats.toolsCalled || 0}}</b></div>
      <div><span>errors</span><b ng-class="{'l-err': c.stats.errors > 0}">{{c.stats.errors || 0}}</b></div>
      <div><span>last model</span><b>{{c.stats.lastModel || '-'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>routing</span><b ng-class="{'on': c.stats.lastRoute === 'complex'}">{{c.stats.lastRoute || '-'}}</b></div>
      <div><span>last latency</span><b>{{c.stats.lastLatencyMs ? (c.stats.lastLatencyMs + ' ms') : '-'}}</b></div>
      <!-- R6 - human turn-taking telemetry -->
      <div><span>barge-ins</span><b ng-class="{'on': c.stats.barges > 0}">{{c.stats.barges || 0}}</b></div>
      <div><span>backchannels</span><b>{{c.stats.backchannels || 0}}</b></div>
      <div><span>ticket mode</span><b class="fc">full control</b></div>
    </section>

    <!-- R1 - REAL-TIME GRAPHS -->
    <section class="netra-dev-graphs" ng-show="c.devTab === 'monitor'">
      <div class="netra-graph-card">
        <div class="netra-graph-title">
          CONFIDENCE <span class="netra-graph-sub">(last 30 utterances)</span>
          <span class="netra-graph-stats">
            now {{c.charts.confLast || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.confSeries.length">%</span>
            <span class="netra-graph-dim"> · min {{c.charts.confMin || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.confSeries.length">%</span></span>
            <span class="netra-graph-dim"> · max {{c.charts.confMax || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.confSeries.length">%</span></span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <svg class="netra-graph-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 50" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <polyline ng-attr-points="{{c.charts.confPath}}" fill="none" stroke="#8ab4f8" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <line x1="0" y1="40" x2="200" y2="40" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-graph-card">
        <div class="netra-graph-title">
          LATENCY <span class="netra-graph-sub">(Gemini, ms)</span>
          <span class="netra-graph-stats">
            now {{c.charts.latLast || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.latSeries.length">ms</span>
            <span class="netra-graph-dim"> · min {{c.charts.latMin || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.latSeries.length">ms</span></span>
            <span class="netra-graph-dim"> · max {{c.charts.latMax || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.latSeries.length">ms</span></span>
            <span class="netra-graph-dim"> · avg {{c.charts.latAvg || 0}}<span ng-show="c.charts.latSeries.length">ms</span></span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <svg class="netra-graph-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 50" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <polyline ng-attr-points="{{c.charts.latPath}}" fill="none" stroke="#a5d6a7" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-graph-card netra-graph-bars">
        <div class="netra-graph-title">TOOL CALLS <span class="netra-graph-sub">({{c.charts.toolTotal || 0}} total)</span></div>
        <div class="netra-bar-row" ng-repeat="bar in c.charts.toolBars | limitTo:6">
          <span class="netra-bar-label">{{bar.name}}</span>
          <div class="netra-bar-track"><div class="netra-bar-fill" ng-style="{width: bar.pct + '%'}"></div></div>
          <span class="netra-bar-count">{{bar.count}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-bar-empty" ng-show="!c.charts.toolBars.length">no tools called yet</div>
      </div>
      <!-- R1.4 - last-turn trace (shows which tools actualy ran) -->
      <div class="netra-graph-card netra-trace" ng-show="c.lastTrace.length">
        <div class="netra-graph-title">LAST TURN TRACE <span class="netra-graph-sub">({{c.lastTrace.length}} tool{{c.lastTrace.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}})</span></div>
        <div class="netra-trace-row" ng-repeat="t in c.lastTrace">
          <span class="netra-trace-step">{{t.order}}</span>
          <span class="netra-trace-name">{{t.name}}</span>
          <span class="netra-trace-arrow">-> </span>
          <span class="netra-trace-ok">ok</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-transcript" ng-show="c.devTab === 'voice' || c.devTab === 'logs'">
      <div class="netra-dev-tx-row"><span>hearing</span><em ng-class="{'on': c.interim}">{{c.interim || '(silent)'}}</em></div>
      <div class="netra-dev-tx-row"><span>last heard</span><em>{{c.lastHeard || '(nothing yet)'}}</em></div>
      <div class="netra-dev-tx-row"><span>last spoken</span><em>{{c.spoken || '(nothing yet)'}}</em></div>
    </section>

    <!-- R7 - CHAT TAB: live conversation transcript -->
    <section class="netra-dev-chat" ng-show="c.devTab === 'chat'" aria-label="Conversation transcript">
      <div class="netra-chat-row" ng-repeat="m in c.convo track by $index" ng-class="'chat-' + m.who">
        <span class="netra-chat-who">{{m.who === 'you' ? 'You' : (m.who === 'netra' ? 'Netra' : '')}}</span>
        <span class="netra-chat-text">{{m.text}}</span>
        <span class="netra-chat-time">{{m.t}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-chat-empty" ng-show="!c.convo.length">no conversation yet - just start talking</div>
      <button class="netra-chat-clear" ng-click="c.devClearConvo()" ng-show="c.convo.length">clear transcript</button>
    </section>

    <!-- R7 - VOICE LAB: pick the neural voice + tune the pace, live -->
    <section class="netra-dev-voicelab" ng-show="c.devTab === 'voice'">
      <div class="netra-voicelab-title">VOICE LAB
        <span class="netra-voicelab-sub">{{c.edgeVoice}} · {{((c.speechRate - 1) * 100).toFixed(0)}}% pace</span>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-voicelab-row">
        <label>voice</label>
        <select ng-model="c.edgeVoice" ng-change="c.devSetEdgeVoice()"
                ng-options="v as v for v in ['en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural','en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural','en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural','en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural','en-US-JennyNeural','en-US-AriaNeural','en-IN-NeerjaNeural','en-IN-AashiNeural','en-IN-AnanyaNeural','hi-IN-SwaraNeural','en-GB-SoniaNeural']"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-voicelab-row">
        <label>pace</label>
        <input type="range" min="0.9" max="1.25" step="0.01" ng-model="c.speechRate" ng-change="c.devSetRate()"/>
        <em>{{c.speechRate}}</em>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-voicelab-row">
        <button ng-click="c.devPreviewVoice()">Preview voice</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-input" ng-show="c.devTab === 'voice'">
      <input type="text"
             ng-model="c.devText"
             placeholder="Type a command (bypass mic), press Enter"
             ng-keydown="c.devKey($event)"
             aria-label="Type a command to test Netra without using your microphone" />
      <button ng-click="c.devSendText()" ng-disabled="!c.devText">Send</button>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-actions" ng-show="c.devTab === 'voice'">
      <button ng-click="c.devListenNow()"   title="Arm command capture without saying Netra">Listen now</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devToggleSleep()" title="Toggle dormant / alert">{{c.alert ? 'Sleep' : 'Wake'}}</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devCloseConversation()" title="Close the follow-up window so wake word is required again"
              ng-disabled="!c.conversationOpen">End conv</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devTestTTS()"     title="Speak a test phrase with the chosen engine">Test TTS</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devToggleTTS()"   title="Cycle Edge Neural -> Gemini Native -> StreamElements -> browser TTS">{{c.ttsEngine === 'edge' ? 'Use Gemini' : c.ttsEngine === 'gemini' ? 'Use Stream' : c.ttsEngine === 'stream' ? 'Use browser' : 'Use Edge'}}</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devCaptureScreen()" title="Capture a frame of your screen for Gemini multimodal analysis">Capture screen</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devCycleRemoteVoice()" title="Cycle voices for the active engine"
              ng-disabled="c.ttsEngine === 'browser'">{{c.ttsEngine === 'edge' ? c.edgeVoice : c.ttsEngine === 'gemini' ? c.geminiVoice : c.remoteVoice}}</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devGreet()"       title="Re-trigger the greeting">Greet</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devReplayLast()"  title="Speak the last response again">Replay</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devRestartRec()"  title="Restart the recognition session">Restart rec</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devDiagnose()"    title="Log diagnostic info (voices, perms, state)">Diagnose</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devPingServer()"  title="Server diagnostic round-trip">Ping server</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devClearLog()"    title="Clear the event log below">Clear log</button>
      <button ng-click="c.devNuclearReset()" title="Wipe Gemini history + restart mic + AudioContext (Alt+Shift+R)">Reset all</button>
    </section>

    <!-- R2.2 - Voice training: personal vocab + alias map -->
    <section class="netra-dev-train" ng-show="c.devTab === 'training'">
      <div class="netra-train-title">VOICE TRAINING
        <span class="netra-train-sub">{{c.vocabCount || 0}} words, {{c.aliasCount || 0}} aliases</span>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-train-row">
        <input ng-model="c.trainText"
               placeholder="Add a word Netra should know (name, project, tool)"
               ng-keydown="$event.keyCode === 13 && c.addTrainingWord()" />
        <button ng-click="c.addTrainingWord()" ng-disabled="!c.trainText">+ Word</button>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-train-row netra-train-alias-row">
        <input ng-model="c.aliasMisheard" placeholder="Netra heard..." class="netra-train-half" />
        <span class="netra-train-arrow">→</span>
        <input ng-model="c.aliasIntended" placeholder="You meant..." class="netra-train-half" />
        <button ng-click="c.addAlias()" ng-disabled="!c.aliasMisheard || !c.aliasIntended">+ Map</button>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-train-aliases" ng-show="c.aliasList.length">
        <div class="netra-train-alias" ng-repeat="a in c.aliasList track by $index">
          <span class="netra-train-alias-misheard">"{{a.misheard}}"</span>
          <span class="netra-train-alias-arrow">→</span>
          <span class="netra-train-alias-intended">"{{a.intended}}"</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="netra-train-clear" ng-click="c.clearTraining()"
              ng-show="c.vocabCount > 0 || c.aliasCount > 0">clear all training</button>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-voices" ng-show="c.voices.length && c.devTab === 'training'">
      <label>
        <span>force voice</span>
        <select ng-model="c.voicePick" ng-change="c.devPickVoice()">
          <option value="">(auto - female en-IN preferred)</option>
          <option ng-repeat="v in c.voices" value="{{v.name}}">{{v.name}} -- {{v.lang}}</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    </section>

    <section class="netra-dev-log" ng-show="c.devTab === 'logs'" aria-label="Event log">
      <div class="netra-dev-log-row" ng-repeat="e in c.events track by $index"
           ng-class="'l-' + e.l">
        <span class="t">{{e.t}}</span>
        <span class="l">{{e.l}}</span>
        <span class="m">{{e.m}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="netra-dev-log-empty" ng-show="!c.events.length">no events yet</div>
    </section>
    </div><!-- /.netra-dev-body -->

    <!-- R2.12 - VS Code-style status bar at bottom.
         Plain text labels — monospace fonts don't carry emoji glyphs so
         we use 2-3 char abbreviations the way VS Code itself does. -->
    <footer class="netra-dev-statusbar" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="seg"><span class="seg-key">STATE</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.state}}</span></span>
      <span class="seg" ng-class="{'err': !c.recRunning}">
        <span class="seg-key">MIC</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.recRunning ? 'rec' : 'off'}}</span>
      </span>
      <span class="seg"><span class="seg-key">LV</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.micLevel || 0}}</span></span>
      <span class="seg" ng-show="c.stats.lastLatencyMs"><span class="seg-key">LAT</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.stats.lastLatencyMs}}ms</span></span>
      <span class="seg" ng-show="c.stats.lastModel && c.stats.lastModel !== '-'"><span class="seg-key">MODEL</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.stats.lastModel}}</span></span>
      <span class="seg" ng-show="c.stats.barges > 0"><span class="seg-key">BRG</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.stats.barges}}</span></span>
      <span class="seg" ng-show="c.stats.errors > 0" ng-class="{'warn': c.stats.errors > 0}"><span class="seg-key">ERR</span><span class="seg-val">{{c.stats.errors}}</span></span>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- Dev toggle badge - shown when dev panel is hidden -->
  <button class="netra-dev-badge" ng-show="!c.devOn && !(c.data && c.data.is_guest)" ng-click="c.toggleDev()"
          aria-label="Show Netra developer panel"
          title="Alt+D to toggle">DEV</button>

  <!-- ====================================================
        R8 - NETRA LIVE STAGE (dedicated portal page /sp?id=netra_live)
        Full-screen live voice surface: deep cosmic canvas,
        one organic clay blob breathing in the centre, quiet status
        line, caption of the last exchange, and two round controls
        (mute / end). The blob paths are driven by the same rAF ticker
        as the floating orb.
        ==================================================== -->
  <div class="netra-stage" ng-if="c.liveMode" ng-class="'netra-stage-' + c.state">
    <!-- R8.1 - PRISM ROOM: layered aurora ribbons + starfield behind the
         blob, all hue-locked to the voice via the prism engine vars. -->
    <div class="netra-stage-aurora netra-stage-aurora-1" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="netra-stage-aurora netra-stage-aurora-2" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="netra-stage-floor" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <!-- R23 - install Netra as an app (Android/desktop prompt; iOS: how to add it) -->
    <button type="button" class="netra-app-btn" ng-if="!c.app.standalone && (c.app.canInstall || c.app.ios)"
            ng-click="c.installApp()" aria-controls="netra-app-help"
            ng-attr-aria-expanded="{{c.app.canInstall ? undefined : (c.app.showHelp ? 'true' : 'false')}}">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 3a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v8.59l2.3-2.3a1 1 0 1 1 1.4 1.42l-4 4a1 1 0 0 1-1.4 0l-4-4a1 1 0 1 1 1.4-1.42l2.3 2.3V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1zm-7 14a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v1h12v-1a1 1 0 1 1 2 0v2a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/></svg>
      <span>Install app</span>
    </button>
    <div class="netra-app-help" id="netra-app-help" ng-if="c.app.showHelp" role="dialog" aria-modal="false" aria-labelledby="netra-app-help-title"
         ng-keydown="c.appHelpKey($event)">
      <div class="netra-app-help-title" id="netra-app-help-title" tabindex="-1">Add Netra to your Home Screen</div>
      <ol>
        <li>Tap the <b>Share</b> button
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 2.5a1 1 0 0 1 .7.3l3.5 3.5a1 1 0 0 1-1.4 1.4L13 5.9V15a1 1 0 1 1-2 0V5.9L9.2 7.7a1 1 0 0 1-1.4-1.4l3.5-3.5a1 1 0 0 1 .7-.3zM6 10a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v8h10v-8a1 1 0 1 1 2 0v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/></svg>
          in {{c.app.shareWhere}}.</li>
        <li>Choose <b>Add to Home Screen</b>, then <b>Add</b>.</li>
      </ol>
      <p>Netra then opens full screen from her own icon, like any app.</p>
      <button type="button" class="netra-app-help-ok" ng-click="c.appHelpClose()">Got it</button>
    </div>
    <header class="netra-stage-head">
      <span class="netra-stage-brand">Netra</span>
      <span class="netra-stage-pill">LIVE</span>
      <span class="netra-stage-pill netra-stage-pill-state">{{c.state}}</span>
    </header>

    <!-- R10 - REAL 3D LAYER: three.js mounts its canvas here (first child
         = painted behind every other stage layer). Stays empty when WebGL
         is unavailable and the 2D blob carries on. -->
    <div class="netra-stage-3d" aria-hidden="true"></div>

    <!-- R9 - PASTEL MESH ENVIRONMENT: five huge ultra-soft gradient blobs
         (coral / lavender / sky / mint / peach) that bloom in while Netra
         talks - the whole room turns into a drifting mesh gradient. -->
    <div class="netra-stage-mesh" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="netra-mesh-blob netra-mesh-1"></div>
      <div class="netra-mesh-blob netra-mesh-2"></div>
      <div class="netra-mesh-blob netra-mesh-3"></div>
      <div class="netra-mesh-blob netra-mesh-4"></div>
      <div class="netra-mesh-blob netra-mesh-5"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- R21 - the loading screen: nothing is accepted until Netra can hear, speak and answer.
         A direct child of the stage, so it covers the Settings tab and the controls too -->
    <!-- R24 - a modal dialog, named by its title and announced once; the one
         polite status line inside changes only when a check passes or a real
         problem shows up (never for a download percentage). Everything behind
         it is made inert by client.js while it is up -->
    <div class="netra-ready" ng-if="c.gate && !c.gate.open && !c.gate.typing && !c.ended" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
         aria-labelledby="netra-ready-title" aria-describedby="netra-ready-status">
      <div class="netra-ready-card">
        <h2 class="netra-ready-title" id="netra-ready-title" tabindex="-1">{{c.gate.everOpen ? 'One moment - Netra is catching up' : 'Netra is getting ready'}}</h2>
        <div class="netra-sr-only" id="netra-ready-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">{{c.gate.status}}</div>
        <div class="netra-ready-sub">{{c.gate.cantHear && c.gate.brain ? 'She can not hear in this browser, but you can type to her.' : 'Please wait - she can not take questions until all three are ready.'}}</div>
        <div class="netra-ready-row" ng-class="{'netra-ready-ok': c.gate.hearing}"><span class="dot"></span><b>Hearing</b><em>{{c.gate.hearingText}}</em></div>
        <div class="netra-ready-row" ng-class="{'netra-ready-ok': c.gate.voice}"><span class="dot"></span><b>Voice</b><em>{{c.gate.voiceText}}</em></div>
        <div class="netra-ready-row" ng-class="{'netra-ready-ok': c.gate.brain}"><span class="dot"></span><b>Answers</b><em>{{c.gate.brainText}}</em></div>
        <div class="netra-ready-actions">
          <button type="button" class="netra-ready-start" ng-if="c.gate.needsTap" ng-click="c.gateActivate()"
                  aria-label="Start Netra. Press Enter so the browser lets her speak.">Start Netra</button>
          <button type="button" class="netra-ready-type" ng-if="c.gate.cantHear && c.gate.brain" ng-click="c.gateType()">Type instead</button>
          <button type="button" class="netra-ready-leave" ng-click="c.liveExit()" aria-label="Leave Netra Live">Leave</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="netra-stage-center">
      <div class="netra-stage-orbit" aria-hidden="true">
        <!-- slow-spinning prism ring behind the blob -->
        <div class="netra-stage-ring"></div>
        <div class="netra-stage-ring netra-stage-ring-2"></div>
        <!-- word-onset ripple rings are appended here from client.js -->
        <div class="netra-stage-ripples"></div>
      </div>
      <button class="netra-stage-blob-wrap" ng-click="c.tap()"
              aria-label="Netra is {{c.stateLabel}}. {{c.ended ? 'Tap to start her again.' : (c.micOff ? 'Tap to unmute.' : (c.alert ? 'Tap to put her to sleep.' : 'Tap to wake her.'))}}">
        <svg class="netra-stage-svg" viewBox="0 0 120 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
          <defs>
            <!-- state-tinted 3D shading, driven by CSS stop-color classes -->
            <radialGradient id="netra-stage-grad" cx="38%" cy="32%" r="70%" fx="34%" fy="28%">
              <stop offset="0%"   class="nsg-0"/>
              <stop offset="24%"  class="nsg-1"/>
              <stop offset="62%"  class="nsg-2"/>
              <stop offset="100%" class="nsg-3"/>
            </radialGradient>
          </defs>
          <path class="netra-stage-blob-outer"/>
          <path class="netra-stage-blob-inner"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <div class="netra-stage-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">{{c.liveStatus}}</div>
      <!-- End for a Guest or the installed app: she rests here, there is nowhere to go back to -->
      <button type="button" class="netra-ended-btn" ng-if="c.ended" ng-click="c.liveRestart()">Start Netra again</button>
      <!-- R8.1 - live captions: her own words while speaking, yours while listening -->
      <div class="netra-stage-caption netra-stage-caption-netra"
           ng-show="c.captionWho() === 'netra'">{{c.spoken}}</div>
      <div class="netra-stage-caption" ng-show="c.captionWho() === 'you'">
        {{c.interim || c.lastHeard}}
      </div>

      <!-- R9 - INTERACTIVE MIC CALIBRATION CARD (every page load).
           Shows the sentence to read, the live transcript while listening,
           and the score when done - with Skip / Try again controls. -->
      <div class="netra-calib-card" ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt' || c.labCalib.stage === 'listening' || c.labCalib.stage === 'done' || c.labCalib.stage === 'timeout'">
        <div class="netra-calib-title">
          MIC CALIBRATION
          <span class="netra-calib-stage">{{c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt' ? 'get ready…' : c.labCalib.stage === 'listening' ? 'read the sentence aloud' : c.labCalib.stage === 'done' ? 'result' : 'no speech heard'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-calib-sentence" ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt' || c.labCalib.stage === 'listening'">
          “{{c.labCalibSentence}}”
        </div>
        <div class="netra-calib-live" ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'listening'">
          <span class="netra-calib-dot"></span>{{c.interim || 'listening…'}}
        </div>
        <div class="netra-calib-result" ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'done'">
          <span class="netra-calib-score">{{c.labCalib.score}}%</span>
          <span class="netra-calib-verdict">{{c.labCalib.verdict}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-calib-result" ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'timeout'">
          <span class="netra-calib-verdict">{{c.labCalib.verdict}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-calib-actions">
          <button ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'listening' || c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt'" ng-click="c.calibSkip()">Skip</button>
          <button ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'done' || c.labCalib.stage === 'timeout'" ng-click="c.calibRetry()">Try again</button>
          <button ng-show="c.labCalib.stage === 'done' || c.labCalib.stage === 'timeout'" ng-click="c.calibDismiss()">Close</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="netra-stage-controls" ng-if="!c.ended">
      <button class="netra-ctl netra-ctl-mic" ng-click="c.toggleMic()"
              ng-class="{'netra-ctl-muted': c.micOff}"
              aria-label="{{c.micOff ? 'Unmute mic' : 'Mute mic'}}"
              title="{{c.micOff ? 'Unmute mic' : 'Mute mic'}}">
        <svg ng-show="!c.micOff" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 14a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V5a3 3 0 0 0-6 0v6a3 3 0 0 0 3 3zm5-3a5 5 0 0 1-10 0H5a7 7 0 0 0 6 6.92V22h2v-4.08A7 7 0 0 0 19 11z"/></svg>
        <svg ng-show="c.micOff" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="22" height="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19 11h-1.7c0 .58-.1 1.13-.27 1.64l1.27 1.27c.44-.88.7-1.87.7-2.91zM4.41 2.86 3 4.27l6 6V11a3 3 0 0 0 4.24 2.74l1.46 1.46A4.98 4.98 0 0 1 12 16a5 5 0 0 1-5-5H5a7 7 0 0 0 6 6.92V22h2v-4.08c.91-.13 1.77-.45 2.54-.9l4.19 4.18 1.41-1.41L4.41 2.86zM15 11V5a3 3 0 0 0-6 0v.18l6 6V11z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="netra-ctl netra-ctl-lab" ng-click="c.labToggle()"
              ng-class="{'netra-ctl-lab-on': c.labOn}"
              aria-expanded="{{c.labOn}}"
              aria-label="Netra Lab: diagnostics and typing" title="Netra Lab">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="21" height="21" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M9 2v2h1v4.35L4.5 18.4A2 2 0 0 0 6.24 21h11.52a2 2 0 0 0 1.74-2.6L14 8.35V4h1V2H9zm3 8.5 3.5 6H8.5l3.5-6z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="netra-ctl netra-ctl-end" ng-click="c.liveExit()"
              aria-label="End" title="End">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19 6.41 17.59 5 12 10.59 6.41 5 5 6.41 10.59 12 5 17.59 6.41 19 12 13.41 17.59 19 19 17.59 13.41 12z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </footer>

    <!-- ====================================================
          R8.1 - NETRA LAB: super-advanced diagnostics console
          (mic spectrum scope, recognition health, STT accuracy
          calibration, brain + hue telemetry)
          ==================================================== -->
    <!-- ====================================================
          R13 - NETRA SETUP: end-user preferences docked LEFT.
          The out-of-box experience: language, voice, pace and
          mic level in one place, like setting up a new phone.
          Opens automatically on the very first visit.
          ==================================================== -->
    <aside class="netra-setup" role="region" aria-label="Netra settings - language, voice and microphone" ng-keydown="c.setupKey($event)">
      <button class="netra-setup-tab" ng-click="c.setupToggle()"
              aria-expanded="{{c.setupOn}}"
              aria-label="{{c.setupOn ? 'Close' : 'Open'}} Netra settings">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M19.14 12.94c.03-.31.05-.62.05-.94s-.02-.63-.05-.94l2.03-1.58a.5.5 0 0 0 .12-.64l-1.92-3.32a.5.5 0 0 0-.61-.22l-2.39.96c-.5-.38-1.04-.7-1.62-.94l-.36-2.54a.5.5 0 0 0-.5-.42h-3.84a.5.5 0 0 0-.5.42l-.36 2.54c-.58.24-1.12.56-1.62.94l-2.39-.96a.5.5 0 0 0-.61.22L2.65 8.84a.5.5 0 0 0 .12.64l2.03 1.58c-.03.31-.05.62-.05.94s.02.63.05.94l-2.03 1.58a.5.5 0 0 0-.12.64l1.92 3.32c.13.23.4.32.61.22l2.39-.96c.5.38 1.04.7 1.62.94l.36 2.54c.04.24.25.42.5.42h3.84c.25 0 .46-.18.5-.42l.36-2.54c.58-.24 1.12-.56 1.62-.94l2.39.96c.21.1.48.01.61-.22l1.92-3.32a.5.5 0 0 0-.12-.64l-2.03-1.58zM12 15.5a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 0-7 3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7z"/></svg>
        <span>Settings</span>
      </button>
      <div class="netra-setup-body" ng-show="c.setupOn">
        <div class="netra-setup-title">MAKE NETRA YOURS</div>
        <div class="netra-setup-sub">saved on this browser, applied instantly</div>
        <button type="button" class="netra-setup-btn" ng-if="!c.app.standalone && (c.app.canInstall || c.app.ios)" ng-click="c.installApp()">Install Netra as an app</button>
        <label class="netra-setup-label" for="netra-set-lang">I speak</label>
        <select id="netra-set-lang" ng-model="c.recLang" ng-change="c.labSetLang()"
                ng-options="l as l for l in c.recLangs"></select>
        <label class="netra-setup-label" for="netra-set-voice">Netra's voice</label>
        <select id="netra-set-voice" ng-model="c.edgeVoice" ng-change="c.devSetEdgeVoice()"
                ng-options="v as v for v in c.edgeVoices"></select>
        <button class="netra-setup-btn" ng-click="c.devPreviewVoice()">Hear this voice</button>
        <label class="netra-setup-label" for="netra-set-rate">Speaking pace <em>{{c.speechRate}}x</em></label>
        <input id="netra-set-rate" type="range" min="0.85" max="1.3" step="0.01"
               ng-model="c.speechRate" ng-change="c.devSetRate()" aria-label="Netra's speaking pace"/>
        <label class="netra-setup-label" for="netra-set-gain">Mic meter sensitivity <em>{{c.micGain}}x</em></label>
        <input id="netra-set-gain" type="range" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1"
               ng-model="c.micGain" ng-change="c.labSetGain()" aria-label="Microphone meter sensitivity"/>
        <div class="netra-setup-meter" aria-hidden="true"><i ng-style="{width: (c.micLevel || 0) + '%'}"></i></div>
        <!-- R14 - morning briefing preference (a Guest has no queue to brief) -->
        <label class="netra-setup-check" ng-if="!(c.data && c.data.is_guest)">
          <input type="checkbox" ng-model="c.prefBrief" ng-change="c.setBrief()"/>
          <span>Morning briefing on my first visit of the day</span>
        </label>
        <button class="netra-setup-btn" ng-click="c.calibRetry()">Run mic check</button>
        <button class="netra-setup-btn netra-setup-ghost" ng-click="c.setupToggle()">Done</button>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <aside class="netra-lab" ng-show="c.labOn" role="dialog" aria-label="Netra Lab diagnostics (draggable window)">
      <header class="netra-lab-head" ng-mousedown="c.labDragStart($event)"
              title="Drag this bar to move the Netra Lab window">
        <span class="netra-lab-grip" aria-hidden="true">⋮⋮</span>
        <span class="netra-lab-title">NETRA LAB</span>
        <span class="netra-lab-sub">audio · recognition · brain</span>
        <button type="button" class="netra-lab-x" ng-click="c.labToggle()" aria-label="Close Netra Lab"><span aria-hidden="true">×</span></button>
      </header>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">MIC SPECTRUM
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-class="{'ok': c.micStreamActive, 'bad': !c.micStreamActive}">
            {{c.micStreamActive ? 'STREAM LIVE' : 'NO STREAM'}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">lvl {{c.micLevel || 0}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">peak {{c.micLevelPeak || 0}}</span>
        </div>
        <canvas class="netra-lab-scope" width="360" height="72" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-slider">
          <label>sensitivity</label>
          <input type="range" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" ng-model="c.micGain" ng-change="c.labSetGain()"
                 aria-label="Microphone sensitivity" />
          <em>{{c.micGain}}x</em>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-btns">
          <button ng-click="c.devTestMic()" ng-disabled="c.micRecording || !c.micStreamActive">Record 3s + playback</button>
          <button ng-click="c.labRestartMic()">Rebuild mic stack</button>
          <em ng-show="c.micTestResult">{{c.micTestResult}}</em>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec" aria-label="What Netra hears, live">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">HEARD (LIVE)
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-class="{'ok': c.interim, 'bad': !c.recRunning}">{{c.interim ? 'hearing…' : (c.recRunning ? 'listening' : 'mic off')}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip bad" ng-show="c.micHealth.speechService === 'unreachable'">speech service unreachable</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip ok" ng-show="c.ear.on">on-device ear</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-show="c.ear.status === 'standby'">ear in standby</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip bad" ng-show="!c.ready">{{c.readyText}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip bad" ng-show="c.gate && !c.gate.open">not ready: {{!c.gate.brain ? 'answers - ' + c.gate.brainText : (!c.gate.hearing ? 'hearing' : 'voice')}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-show="c.ear.status === 'loading'">loading ear {{c.ear.progress}}%</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip bad" ng-show="c.micHealth.deafStrikes && !c.ear.on">sound without words ×{{c.micHealth.deafStrikes}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-hearing" ng-class="{'on': c.interim}">{{c.interim || 'say something - words appear here as they are recognised'}}</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-selects">
          <label>ear</label>
          <select ng-model="c.ear.mode" ng-change="c.labSetEar()" ng-options="m as m for m in ['auto','on','off']" aria-label="Which ear hears you: automatic, the on-device one, or the browser only"></select>
          <select ng-model="c.ear.size" ng-change="c.labSetEarSize()" ng-options="m as (m === 'auto' ? 'model: auto' : (m === 'tiny' ? 'model: tiny (fast)' : 'model: base (clear)')) for m in ['auto','tiny','base']" aria-label="On-device model: tiny is fastest, base is clearer"></select>
          <em class="netra-lab-ear-status">{{c.earSummary()}}</em>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-heard-row" ng-repeat="h in c.heard track by $index">
          <span class="t">{{h.t}}</span><span class="cf">{{h.conf}}</span><em>“{{h.text}}”</em><span class="f">{{h.fate}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-kv" ng-show="!c.heard.length"><span>finals</span><em>none yet this session</em></div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">LANGUAGE + VOICE</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-selects">
          <label>hear in</label>
          <select ng-model="c.recLang" ng-change="c.labSetLang()"
                  ng-options="l as l for l in c.recLangs"
                  aria-label="Speech recognition language"></select>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-selects">
          <label>speak with</label>
          <select ng-model="c.edgeVoice" ng-change="c.devSetEdgeVoice()"
                  ng-options="v as v for v in ['en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural','en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural','en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural','en-US-BrianMultilingualNeural','en-US-JennyNeural','en-US-AriaNeural','en-IN-NeerjaNeural','en-IN-AashiNeural','en-IN-AnanyaNeural','hi-IN-SwaraNeural','en-GB-SoniaNeural']"
                  aria-label="Netra's speaking voice"></select>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-btns">
          <button ng-click="c.devPreviewVoice()">Preview voice</button>
          <button ng-click="c.devToggleTTS()">Engine: {{c.ttsEngine}}</button>
          <label class="netra-lab-check"><input type="checkbox" ng-model="c.labMute" ng-change="c.labSetMute()"/> mute TTS</label>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">TYPE A COMMAND (no mic needed)</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-cmd">
          <input type="text" ng-model="c.labCmd" ng-keydown="c.labCmdKey($event)"
                 placeholder="e.g. list my tickets / resolve INC0010005"
                 aria-label="Type a command for Netra" />
          <button ng-click="c.labSendCmd()" ng-disabled="!c.labCmd">Send</button>
        </div>
        <!-- her answer, right here: on a phone the Lab covers the stage caption -->
        <div class="netra-lab-answer" ng-show="c.spoken"><b>Netra</b> {{c.spoken}}</div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">NLP TEST (live - real actions)</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-cmd">
          <input type="text" ng-model="c.labNlpText" ng-keydown="c.labNlpKey($event)"
                 placeholder="e.g. what buttons are on INC0000059?"
                 aria-label="NLP test utterance - runs for real" />
          <button ng-click="c.labRunNlp()" ng-disabled="!c.labNlpText">Run</button>
        </div>
        <div ng-show="c.labNlp">
          <div class="netra-lab-kv"><span>sent</span><em>{{c.labNlp.sent}}</em></div>
          <div class="netra-lab-kv"><span>tools</span><em>{{c.labNlp.tools.length ? c.labNlp.tools.join(' → ') : '(none)'}}</em></div>
          <div class="netra-lab-kv"><span>reply</span><em>{{c.labNlp.reply}}</em></div>
          <div class="netra-lab-kv" ng-show="c.labNlp.ms"><span>latency</span><em>{{c.labNlp.ms}} ms</em></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">STT ACCURACY / CALIBRATION
          <span class="netra-lab-chip ok" ng-show="c.labCalib.score !== null">score {{c.labCalib.score}}%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-calib-sentence">“{{c.labCalibSentence}}”</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-btns">
          <button ng-click="c.labStartCalibration()" ng-disabled="c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt' || c.labCalib.stage === 'listening'">
            {{c.labCalib.stage === 'listening' ? 'Listening…' : c.labCalib.stage === 'prompt' ? 'Speaking…' : 'Run calibration test'}}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-kv" ng-show="c.labCalib.heard"><span>heard</span><em>{{c.labCalib.heard}}</em></div>
        <div class="netra-lab-kv" ng-show="c.labCalib.verdict"><span>verdict</span><em>{{c.labCalib.verdict}}</em></div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">RECOGNITION HEALTH (SENTINEL)</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-grid">
          <div><span>recognition</span><b ng-class="{'bad': !c.recRunning}">{{c.recRunning ? 'RUNNING' : 'STOPPED'}}</b></div>
          <div><span>permission</span><b ng-class="{'bad': c.permission === 'denied'}">{{c.permission}}</b></div>
          <div><span>speech service</span><b ng-class="{'bad': c.micHealth.speechService === 'unreachable'}">{{c.micHealth.speechService || 'ok'}}</b></div>
          <div><span>network errors</span><b ng-class="{'warn': c.micHealth.networkErrors > 0}">{{c.micHealth.networkErrors || 0}}</b></div>
          <div><span>session age</span><b>{{c.labSessionAgeS()}}s</b></div>
          <div><span>last final</span><b>{{c.labLastFinalAgo()}}</b></div>
          <div><span>last interim</span><b>{{c.labLastInterimAgo()}}</b></div>
          <div><span>sr restarts</span><b>{{c.micHealth.srRestarts}}</b></div>
          <div><span>full recycles</span><b>{{c.micHealth.fullRecycles}}</b></div>
          <div><span>preventive</span><b>{{c.micHealth.preventiveRecycles}}</b></div>
          <div><span>zombie heals</span><b ng-class="{'warn': c.micHealth.syntheticFinals > 0}">{{c.micHealth.syntheticFinals}}</b></div>
          <div><span>floor clears</span><b ng-class="{'warn': c.micHealth.floorClears > 0}">{{c.micHealth.floorClears}}</b></div>
          <div><span>perm recoveries</span><b>{{c.micHealth.notAllowedRecoveries + c.micHealth.deniedRecoveries}}</b></div>
          <div><span>calib score</span><b>{{c.micHealth.lastCalibScore !== undefined ? c.micHealth.lastCalibScore + '%' : '-'}}</b></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">BRAIN + VOICE</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-grid">
          <div><span>state</span><b>{{c.state}}</b></div>
          <div><span>model</span><b>{{c.stats.lastModel || '-'}}</b></div>
          <div><span>latency</span><b>{{c.stats.lastLatencyMs ? c.stats.lastLatencyMs + 'ms' : '-'}}</b></div>
          <div><span>tools called</span><b>{{c.stats.toolsCalled || 0}}</b></div>
          <div><span>errors</span><b ng-class="{'warn': c.stats.errors > 0}">{{c.stats.errors || 0}}</b></div>
          <div><span>voice</span><b>{{c.voiceSummary()}}</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-btns">
          <button ng-click="c.devTestTTS()">Test TTS</button>
          <button ng-click="c.devToggleTTS()">Cycle engine</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">PRISM HUE ENGINE</div>
        <div class="netra-lab-hue-row">
          <span class="netra-lab-swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">hue {{c.labHue()}}°</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">amp {{c.labAmp()}}%</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">60fps · voice-modulated</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">3D {{c.lab3dFps()}} fps</span>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- R11 - DEEP MEMORY: what she remembers right now, live -->
      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">DEEP MEMORY
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-if="c.mem.restored">restored {{c.mem.restored}} prompts after refresh</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-grid">
          <div><span>your prompts</span><b>{{c.mem.prompts}}</b></div>
          <div><span>live window</span><b>last 50 + digest</b></div>
          <div><span>total turns</span><b>{{c.mem.entries}}</b></div>
          <div><span>size</span><b>~{{c.mem.kb}} KB</b></div>
          <div><span>survives refresh</span><b>yes (this tab)</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row netra-lab-btns">
          <button ng-click="c.memForget()">Forget everything</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- R18 - BRAIN: the quota governor's ledger - which model is up, how
           much of its free daily pool is gone, and when resting ones return -->
      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">BRAIN
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">{{c.brain.alive}} of {{c.brain.models.length}} up</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-if="c.brain.mode !== 'full'">{{c.brain.mode}}</span>
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">last turn: {{c.brain.calls}} call{{c.brain.calls === 1 ? '' : 's'}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-feed" role="list" aria-label="Reasoning model quota">
          <div class="netra-lab-feed-row" role="listitem" ng-repeat="m in c.brain.models track by m.model">
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-t">{{m.model.replace('gemini-','')}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-k" ng-class="{'lk-warn': m.resting, 'lk-mem': !m.resting}">{{m.resting ? 'resting' : 'up'}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-m">{{m.used_today}}{{m.limit ? ' / ' + m.limit : ''}} today<span ng-if="m.resting"> · {{m.reason.replace('_',' ')}}, back in {{c.brainUntil(m.until_ms)}}</span></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- R17 - AGENCY: what she is doing on her own, and what she has
           learned about you - the transparency card for the autonomy tier -->
      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">AGENCY
          <span class="netra-lab-chip" ng-if="c.agency.plan">plan {{c.agency.plan.done}}/{{c.agency.plan.total}}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-feed" role="log" aria-label="Standing orders">
          <div class="netra-lab-feed-row" ng-repeat="o in c.agency.orders track by o.nt">
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-t">{{o.nt}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-k" ng-class="{'lk-warn': o.state === 'error', 'lk-mem': o.state === 'active'}">{{o.state}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-m">{{o.action}} · {{o.target}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="netra-lab-feed-row" ng-if="!c.agency.orders.length">
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-m">no standing orders - try "watch INC... and nudge the assignee if nothing moves"</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-grid">
          <div><span>corrections learned</span><b>{{c.agency.corrections}}</b></div>
          <div><span>saved facts</span><b>{{c.agency.facts}}</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-row" ng-if="c.agency.addendum" style="white-space:pre-wrap; opacity:.85; font-size:11px;" aria-label="What Netra knows about you">{{c.agency.addendum}}</div>
      </section>

      <!-- R11 - BACKGROUND FEED: the live event log, same stream the old
           dev console had - so you can watch what she does behind the
           scenes right from the Live page -->
      <section class="netra-lab-sec">
        <div class="netra-lab-sec-title">BACKGROUND FEED
          <span class="netra-lab-chip">{{c.events.length}} events</span>
        </div>
        <div class="netra-lab-feed" role="log" aria-label="Background activity feed">
          <div class="netra-lab-feed-row" ng-repeat="e in c.events track by $index">
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-t">{{e.t}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-k" ng-class="'lk-' + e.l">{{e.l}}</span>
            <span class="netra-lab-feed-m">{{e.m}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="netra-lab-feed-row" ng-if="!c.events.length"><span class="netra-lab-feed-m">nothing yet - say something</span></div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <!-- ====================================================
        ORB - inline SVG (R2.5 - 3D golden-ratio orb)

        Designed strictly to Leonardo da Vinci's golden ratio
        (phi = 1.61803). Every radius and position derives from
        phi-spacing of the previous - so the eye is mathematically
        beautiful, not just decoratively so.

        Radii (50 / phi^n):
          50      - outer halo + sphere edge
          30.901  - limbal ring (50/phi)
          19.098  - iris-mid band (50/phi^2)
          11.803  - iris-inner (50/phi^3)
           7.295  - pupil radius (50/phi^4)
           4.508  - primary catchlight (50/phi^5)
           2.787  - secondary catchlight (50/phi^6)

        Catchlight position at the golden-section point (1-1/phi) =
        0.382 of the way from centre to edge, at 137.5 degrees from
        the +x axis (the golden angle, 360/phi^2).

        Inscribed pentagram (5 vertices, golden-ratio diagonals)
        floats faintly within the iris as a homage to da Vinci.

        3D effect: sphere shading from upper-left, drop shadow
        beneath, inner rim shadow, rim light on the lower-right
        edge - the classic four-light setup.
        ==================================================== -->
  <button class="netra-orb" ng-if="!c.liveMode"
          ng-mousedown="c.dragStart($event)"
          ng-click="c.tap()"
          aria-label="Netra is {{c.stateLabel}}. Drag to move, double-click to shrink."
          title="Drag to reposition - double-click to shrink - single-click to sleep or wake">
    <svg class="netra-eye-svg" viewBox="0 0 120 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <!-- 3D sphere shading (light from upper-left) -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-sphere" cx="36%" cy="32%" r="68%" fx="32%" fy="28%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
          <stop offset="8%"   stop-color="#d6ffe8"/>
          <stop offset="22%"  stop-color="var(--iris-bright, #7fffb0)"/>
          <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="var(--iris-mid, #2eb858)"/>
          <stop offset="82%"  stop-color="var(--iris-dark, #0a4a25)"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="var(--iris-deep, #021a0d)"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Pupil deep core with bright inner reflection -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-pupil" cx="50%" cy="48%" r="55%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="var(--core-mid, #aef0d0)" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
          <stop offset="22%"  stop-color="#001a0a"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Outer halo (pulses + state-driven expansion) -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-halo" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="var(--eye-glow, rgba(127,255,176,0.65))"/>
          <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="var(--eye-glow, rgba(127,255,176,0.22))"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(127,255,176,0)"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Voice ring fill: case-hardened violet patina. Brightest just outside
             the sphere edge (deep violet), patinas through magenta to an amber
             heat-treatment edge, fades through bright violet, then transparent. -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-voice-gradient" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"/>
          <stop offset="48%"  stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"/>
          <stop offset="50%"  class="nvg-core" stop-color="rgba(139, 61, 240, 0.95)"/>
          <stop offset="60%"  class="nvg-mid"  stop-color="rgba(190, 90, 235, 0.80)"/>
          <stop offset="72%"  class="nvg-hot"  stop-color="rgba(255, 170,  80, 0.55)"/>
          <stop offset="86%"  class="nvg-edge" stop-color="rgba(160,  64, 232, 0.35)"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(90,  26, 160, 0)"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <!-- Voice ring stroke: linear gradient across the bounding box gives the
             mottled multi-tone look of case-hardened steel (deep violet -> bright
             magenta -> golden amber heat-treatment patch -> back to deep violet). -->
        <linearGradient id="netra-voice-stroke-gradient" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
                        x1="0" y1="0" x2="120" y2="120">
          <stop offset="0%"   class="nvs-a" stop-color="#6920b8"/>
          <stop offset="25%"  class="nvs-b" stop-color="#8b3df0"/>
          <stop offset="48%"  class="nvs-b2" stop-color="#c660ff"/>
          <stop offset="62%"  class="nvs-c" stop-color="#ffb84d"/>
          <stop offset="80%"  class="nvs-b" stop-color="#a040e8"/>
          <stop offset="100%" class="nvs-d" stop-color="#5a1aa0"/>
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- R7/R8 - inner blob sheen: a soft off-centre highlight (light
             hitting clay from upper-left), NOT a centred pupil. Warm violet
             glow that swells when Netra speaks. -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-blob-inner-gradient" cx="40%" cy="36%" r="58%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="rgba(245,238,255,0.55)"/>
          <stop offset="26%"  stop-color="rgba(216,180,255,0.30)"/>
          <stop offset="58%"  stop-color="rgba(150,90,235,0.14)"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(139,61,240,0)"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Rim light gradient (highlight on lower-right edge) -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-rim" cx="74%" cy="76%" r="48%">
          <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,0)"/>
          <stop offset="70%"  stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,0)"/>
          <stop offset="95%"  stop-color="var(--iris-bright, rgba(174,240,208,0.55))"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(255,255,255,0)"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Inner cast shadow (gives the depth-inset look at the rim) -->
        <radialGradient id="netra-inner-shadow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="75%" stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"/>
          <stop offset="92%" stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0.25)"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(0,0,0,0.55)"/>
        </radialGradient>

        <!-- Soft drop shadow filter -->
        <filter id="netra-drop" x="-15%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2.5"/>
          <feOffset dx="0" dy="3"/>
          <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5"/></feComponentTransfer>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
        <!-- Case-hardened violet glow for the voice ring (SVG-native so the
             SCSS compiler can't strip it). Three Gaussian blurs at different
             radii give a soft inner violet, mid magenta, outer amber halo. -->
        <filter id="netra-violet-glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur1"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-1" flood-color="#a050f0" flood-opacity="0.75" result="violet"/>
          <feComposite in="violet" in2="blur1" operator="in" result="violetGlow"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="4" result="blur2"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-2" flood-color="#be5aeb" flood-opacity="0.45" result="magenta"/>
          <feComposite in="magenta" in2="blur2" operator="in" result="magentaGlow"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="8" result="blur3"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-3" flood-color="#ffaa50" flood-opacity="0.30" result="amber"/>
          <feComposite in="amber" in2="blur3" operator="in" result="amberGlow"/>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode in="amberGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="magentaGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="violetGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
        <!-- Speaking-state aura: wider, more vibrant, with a fourth deep-violet outer halo. -->
        <filter id="netra-violet-glow-speaking" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="2" result="b1"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-1" flood-color="#a050f0" flood-opacity="0.90" result="c1"/>
          <feComposite in="c1" in2="b1" operator="in" result="g1"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="6" result="b2"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-2" flood-color="#be5aeb" flood-opacity="0.60" result="c2"/>
          <feComposite in="c2" in2="b2" operator="in" result="g2"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="11" result="b3"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-3" flood-color="#ffaa50" flood-opacity="0.40" result="c3"/>
          <feComposite in="c3" in2="b3" operator="in" result="g3"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="18" result="b4"/>
          <feFlood class="nfl-4" flood-color="#8b3df0" flood-opacity="0.18" result="c4"/>
          <feComposite in="c4" in2="b4" operator="in" result="g4"/>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode in="g4"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g3"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g2"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g1"/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>

      <!-- ALL geometry centred at 60,60 in the 120x120 viewBox so we
           have room around the sphere for drop shadow + halo bleed -->

      <!-- R2.8.2 - AUDIO-REACTIVE VOICE RING
           24 outer points computed in client.js as c.voiceRingPoints
           "x1,y1 x2,y2 ..." Single polygon connects all 24 tops; an
           outer stroke polyline traces the connected waveform.
           Filled with a translucent gradient so it reads as a halo
           of energy outside the sphere. Spike multiplier 2x the
           previous (0.40-0.50 vs 0.18-0.25). -->
      <!-- R7 - LIQUID AURA (GPT-Live style). The spiky 24-vertex polygon
           is replaced by two smooth spline blobs whose `d` attributes are
           written straight from the client's rAF ticker (no Angular
           binding - 60fps without digests). Outer aura + counter-phased
           inner core; both breathe on idle and surge with speech. -->
      <g class="netra-voice-ring-group" ng-show="c.alert">
        <path class="netra-voice-blob-outer"
              fill="url(#netra-voice-gradient)"
              stroke="none"
              ng-attr-filter="{{c.state === 'speaking' ? 'url(#netra-violet-glow-speaking)' : 'url(#netra-violet-glow)'}}"/>
        <path class="netra-voice-blob-inner"
              fill="url(#netra-blob-inner-gradient)"
              stroke="none"
              opacity="0.75"/>
        <path class="netra-voice-blob-stroke"
              fill="none"
              stroke="url(#netra-voice-stroke-gradient)"
              stroke-width="1.1"
              stroke-linejoin="round"
              ng-attr-filter="{{c.state === 'speaking' ? 'url(#netra-violet-glow-speaking)' : 'url(#netra-violet-glow)'}}"/>
      </g>

      <!-- R8.1 - speaking echo rings: three staggered expanding circles,
           visible only in the speaking state (CSS), hue-locked via
           --eye-glow so they always match the current voice colour. -->
      <g class="netra-orb-echoes" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle class="netra-orb-echo netra-orb-echo-1" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none"/>
        <circle class="netra-orb-echo netra-orb-echo-2" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none"/>
        <circle class="netra-orb-echo netra-orb-echo-3" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Outermost soft halo, pulses via CSS -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-halo" cx="60" cy="60" r="58" fill="url(#netra-halo)"/>

      <!-- The 3D sphere (r=50, the unit) -->
      <g filter="url(#netra-drop)">
        <circle class="netra-eye-sphere" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-sphere)"/>
        <!-- Inner ring/cast shadow gives the look of an inset orb -->
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-inner-shadow)"/>
        <!-- Rim light from lower-right (golden-angle counter-light) -->
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-rim)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- LIMBAL RING at radius 50/phi = 30.901 (the dark band marking
           where iris meets sclera in a healthy human eye) -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-iris" cx="60" cy="60" r="30.901" fill="none"
              stroke="rgba(0,20,10,0.45)" stroke-width="1.2"/>

      <!-- IRIS MID-BAND at radius 50/phi^2 = 19.098 - subtle ring -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="19.098" fill="none"
              stroke="var(--iris-bright, rgba(127,255,176,0.55))" stroke-width="0.5"
              stroke-dasharray="2 3" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- INSCRIBED PENTAGRAM (homage to da Vinci) - five vertices
           at radius 19.098 around centre, drawn as a connected star.
           Vertex angles: -90, -18, 54, 126, 198 degrees.
           Each line skips one vertex to make the star. -->
      <g class="netra-eye-pentagram" opacity="0.18">
        <polygon
          points="60,40.902 78.166,53.106 71.235,74.453 48.765,74.453 41.834,53.106"
          fill="none"
          stroke="var(--iris-bright, #aef0d0)" stroke-width="0.4"/>
        <!-- The actual five-pointed star formed by connecting every other vertex -->
        <path d="M 60 40.902 L 71.235 74.453 L 41.834 53.106 L 78.166 53.106 L 48.765 74.453 Z"
              fill="none" stroke="var(--iris-bright, #aef0d0)" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      </g>

      <!-- IRIS INNER at radius 50/phi^3 = 11.803 - pupil border ring -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="11.803" fill="none"
              stroke="var(--iris-bright, rgba(127,255,176,0.7))" stroke-width="0.5"/>

      <!-- PUPIL at radius 50/phi^4 = 7.295 -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-pupil" cx="60" cy="60" r="7.295" fill="url(#netra-pupil)"/>

      <!-- PRIMARY CATCHLIGHT at the golden-section point.
           Distance from centre = 0.382 * 50 = 19.098.
           Angle = 137.5 degrees (the golden angle from +x axis),
           which lands the catchlight in the upper-left quadrant.
           cx = 60 + 19.098 * cos(137.5 deg) = 60 + 19.098 * -0.7373 = 45.92
           cy = 60 - 19.098 * sin(137.5 deg) = 60 - 19.098 *  0.6756 = 47.10
           Catchlight radius = 50/phi^5 = 4.508 -->
      <ellipse class="netra-eye-glint" cx="45.92" cy="47.1" rx="4.508" ry="3.6"
               fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="45.92" cy="47.1" rx="2.4" ry="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

      <!-- SECONDARY CATCHLIGHT at the OPPOSITE golden-section point.
           Distance 0.382 * 50 = 19.098, angle = 137.5 + 180 = 317.5 deg,
           which lands in the lower-right quadrant.
           cx = 60 + 19.098 * cos(317.5) = 60 + 19.098 *  0.7373 = 74.08
           cy = 60 - 19.098 * sin(317.5) = 60 - 19.098 * -0.6756 = 72.90
           Radius = 50/phi^6 = 2.787 -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-glint-small" cx="74.08" cy="72.9" r="2.787"
              fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)"/>

      <!-- Eyelid (only used in dormant state - covers iris when closed) -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-lid-top" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="#0a1a14" opacity="0"/>
      <!-- R6 - involuntary blink: a second lid that flicks closed for
           ~140ms on a long randomized-feeling cycle (CSS keyframes), so
           the eye reads as alive rather than painted. Hidden in dormant
           (the main lid is already down). -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-blink" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="#0a1a14" opacity="0"/>
    </svg>
  </button>

  <!-- Transcript card REMOVED in R2.12.2.
       For end users, screen-reader narration via the aria-live regions
       above is the canonical interface. The transcript card was the
       yellow-marked element the user asked to remove permanently;
       the popup-blocked fallback link moved to the dev panel only. -->
  <a class="netra-card-link" ng-show="c.pendingOpenUrl"
     ng-href="{{c.pendingOpenUrl}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
     ng-click="c.pendingOpenUrl = null">Click here to open {{c.pendingOpenUrl}}</a>

  <!-- Initial-gesture gate -->
  <button class="netra-gate"
          ng-show="c.needsTap && !c.liveMode"
          ng-click="c.tap()"
          aria-label="Press here to start Netra. Press once and Netra will begin listening.">
    <span class="netra-gate-icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="34" height="34"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 14a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V5a3 3 0 0 0-6 0v6a3 3 0 0 0 3 3zm5-3a5 5 0 0 1-10 0H5a7 7 0 0 0 6 6.92V22h2v-4.08A7 7 0 0 0 19 11z"/></svg>
    </span>
    <span class="netra-gate-text">
      <strong>Press here to start Netra</strong>
      <span>Talk naturally - you can interrupt her any time, just start speaking. Say "stop listening" to pause.</span>
    </span>
  </button>

</div>
]]></template></sp_widget><sys_attachment <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>command</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST resource: POST /api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/command
 *
 * Request body:
 *   {
 *     "transcript": "create a ticket for my email is down",
 *     "pending":    "ticket_description" | "pause_duration" | "resolve_number" |
 *                   "kb_query" | "chat_reply_body" | "confirm_destructive" | null
 *   }
 *
 * Response (always HTTP 200 - errors are returned in the body as ok=false
 * so the widget can speak them):
 *   {
 *     ok, intent, message, data, refresh_tickets, stop, navigate,
 *     pending, clear_pending, paused
 *   }
 */
(function process(request, response) {

    try {
        var body = (request.body && request.body.data) ? request.body.data : {};
        var transcript     = String(body.transcript || '').trim();
        var pendingContext = body.pending ? String(body.pending) : null;

        if (!transcript) {
            return {
                ok: false,
                message: 'No transcript provided. Say something or click the mic again.'
            };
        }

        var intent;
        try {
            intent = new NetraIntent().parse(transcript, pendingContext);
        } catch (eIntent) {
            gs.error('[NetraCommand] NetraIntent failed: ' + eIntent);
            return {
                ok: false,
                message: 'Intent parser is not loaded. Please paste the latest NetraIntent script.'
            };
        }

        var responder;
        try {
            responder = new NetraResponder();
        } catch (eResp) {
            gs.error('[NetraCommand] NetraResponder construct failed: ' + eResp);
            return {
                ok: false,
                message: 'Responder failed to initialise: ' + String(eResp.message || eResp)
            };
        }

        var result;
        try {
            result = responder.handle(intent);
        } catch (eHandle) {
            gs.error('[NetraCommand] handle() threw on action ' + intent.action + ': ' + eHandle);
            return {
                ok: false,
                intent: intent,
                message: 'I tried, but the ' + intent.action + ' action errored: ' + String(eHandle.message || eHandle)
            };
        }

        return {
            ok:              !!result.ok,
            intent:          intent,
            message:         result.message,
            data:            result.data || null,
            refresh_tickets: !!result.refresh_tickets,
            stop:            !!result.stop,
            navigate:        result.navigate || null,
            pending:         result.pending || null,
            clear_pending:   !!result.clear_pending,
            paused:          (typeof result.paused === 'boolean') ? result.paused : null
        };

    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[NetraCommand] unexpected: ' + e + (e.stack ? ' | ' + String(e.stack).split('\n')[0] : ''));
        return {
            ok: false,
            message: 'Server error: ' + String(e.message || e)
        };
    }

})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/command</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/command</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>bcb3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10a0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>command</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_bcb3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10a0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Netra Voice">f8b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba1066</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
