<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>ping</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST resource: GET /api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/ping
 *
 * Debug-only. Returns a small JSON document that proves:
 *   - the Scripted REST API is reachable
 *   - authentication worked
 *   - the script in this resource is being executed
 *
 * Use this any time the widget reports a 400. If /ping ALSO 400s, the
 * problem is the API plumbing (scope, ACL, resource not active, etc.).
 * If /ping succeeds but /command 400s, the problem is somewhere in
 * NetraIntent / NetraResponder / one of the helper Script Includes.
 *
 * Try it in the browser address bar:
 *   https://YOUR-INSTANCE.service-now.com/api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/ping
 *
 * Expected:
 *   { "ok": true, "now": "2026-...", "scope": "x_196061_netra_v1",
 *     "user": "<your sys_id>", "user_name": "<your username>",
 *     "scripts": { "NetraIntent": true, "NetraResponder": true, ... } }
 */
(function process(request, response) {

    var out = {
        ok: true,
        now: String(new GlideDateTime()),
        scope: 'x_196061_netra_v1',
        user: '',
        user_name: '',
        scripts: {}
    };

    try { out.user = String(gs.getUserID()); } catch (e) {}
    try { out.user_name = String(gs.getUserName()); } catch (e) {}

    // Probe each Script Include - true if the constructor doesn't throw
    [
        'NetraIntent', 'NetraTools', 'NetraResponder', 'NetraScanner',
        'NetraKnowledge', 'NetraChat', 'NetraSummarizer', 'NetraContext',
        'NetraNavigator'
    ].forEach(function (name) {
        try {
            var ctor = (typeof x_196061_netra_v1 !== 'undefined' && x_196061_netra_v1[name]) ||
                       (typeof global !== 'undefined' && global[name]);
            // Fall back: evaluate by name in this scope
            if (!ctor) {
                /*jshint evil:true */
                ctor = eval(name);
            }
            new ctor();
            out.scripts[name] = true;
        } catch (e) {
            out.scripts[name] = String(e.message || e);
        }
    });

    // Probe each table
    out.tables = {};
    ['notification', 'user_pref', 'context', 'watchlist'].forEach(function (suffix) {
        var tableName = 'x_196061_netra_v1_' + suffix;
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);
            out.tables[tableName] = gr.isValid();
        } catch (e) {
            out.tables[tableName] = String(e.message || e);
        }
    });

    return out;

})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/ping</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/ping</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>f0b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10c5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ping</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_f0b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10c5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Netra Voice">f8b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba1066</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>notifications</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST resource: GET /api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/notifications
 *
 * Returns AND consumes (marks delivered) any pending Netra notifications
 * for the current user - UNLESS the user has paused notifications, in
 * which case it returns an empty list (without consuming).
 *
 * Response (always HTTP 200):
 *   {
 *     ok, paused, paused_until,
 *     notifications: [ { id, ticket_number, ticket_sys_id, message, kind, created } ]
 *   }
 */
(function process(request, response) {

    try {
        var user = gs.getUserID();

        // Check pause state
        var pref = new GlideRecord('x_196061_netra_v1_user_pref');
        pref.addQuery('user', user);
        pref.setLimit(1);
        pref.query();
        var paused = false;
        var pausedUntil = null;
        if (pref.next()) {
            var pu = pref.paused_until;
            if (pu && String(pu) !== '') {
                var now = new GlideDateTime();
                if (new GlideDateTime(String(pu)).compareTo(now) > 0) {
                    paused = true;
                    pausedUntil = String(pu);
                } else {
                    // Pause window expired - clear it
                    pref.paused_until = '';
                    pref.update();
                }
            }
        }

        if (paused) {
            return { ok: true, paused: true, paused_until: pausedUntil, notifications: [] };
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_196061_netra_v1_notification');
        gr.addQuery('user', user);
        gr.addQuery('delivered', false);
        gr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(10);
        gr.query();

        var out = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            out.push({
                id:             String(gr.sys_id),
                ticket_number:  String(gr.ticket_number),
                ticket_sys_id:  String(gr.ticket_sys_id),
                message:        String(gr.message),
                kind:           String(gr.kind),
                created:        String(gr.sys_created_on)
            });
            gr.delivered    = true;
            gr.delivered_at = new GlideDateTime();
            gr.update();
        }

        return { ok: true, paused: false, paused_until: null, notifications: out };

    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[NetraNotifications] error: ' + e);
        return {
            ok: false,
            paused: false,
            paused_until: null,
            notifications: [],
            error: String(e.message || e)
        };
    }

})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_196061_netra_v1/voice/notifications</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/notifications</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>f4b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10a8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>notifications</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_f4b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10a8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="Netra Voice">f8b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba1066</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>false</advanced><business_calendar/><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><entered_run_end/><entered_run_start/><entered_time/><max_drift/><name>Netra Watch</name><offset/><offset_type>0</offset_type><repeat_every/><run_as display_value="System Administrator">6816f79cc0a8016401c5a33be04be441</run_as><run_as_tz/><run_dayofmonth>1</run_dayofmonth><run_dayofweek/><run_daysofweek/><run_end/><run_month/><run_period>1970-01-01 00:05:00</run_period><run_start>2026-09-23 17:15:09</run_start><run_time/><run_type>periodically</run_type><run_weekinmonth/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scheduled Job: "Netra Watch"
 *
 * Configuration (set when creating the job in Studio):
 *   Run:           Periodically
 *   Repeat every:  3 minutes
 *   Active:        true
 *
 * Behaviour: delegates to NetraScanner. Wraps in a try/catch so a single
 * bad row doesn't take down the schedule.
 */
(function () {
    try {
        new NetraScanner().run();
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('[NetraWatch] scheduled run failed: ' + e + '\n' + e.stack);
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-09 04:41:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>41b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10c9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Netra Watch</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysauto_script_41b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10c9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 17:15:05</sys_updated_on><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe></sysauto_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_journal_field</collection><condition/><description>Async after-insert on sys_journal_field; enqueues a Netra notification.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Netra Notify On Comment</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business Rule: "Netra Notify On Comment"  (v3.4 - scope-safe, no introspection)
 *
 * Configuration in Studio:
 *   Table:        sys_journal_field
 *   Application:  Netra_V1
 *   When:         after
 *   Insert:       true
 *   Advanced:     true
 *   Active:       true
 *   Filter:       (leave blank - the script gates internally)
 *
 * v3.4 changes (after BR fired but no records created):
 *   - REMOVED getFields() (fenced in scope)
 *   - REMOVED dynamic sys_dictionary discovery (was working but slow)
 *   - Uses a HARDCODED list of common user-reference fields. Tries to read
 *     each one via parent.getValue() - silently skips fields that don't
 *     exist on this particular table. Works for incident, change_request,
 *     sc_task, problem, sc_request, kb_knowledge_submission, and any
 *     custom task-derived table without any introspection.
 *   - Adds system property "x_196061_netra_v1.notify_author" (default false).
 *     Set to true temporarily during testing so self-comments produce
 *     notifications (otherwise the author is correctly skipped).
 *   - Aggressive gs.info logging at EVERY step so you can see exactly
 *     what happened by filtering System Logs by "NetraNotify".
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null on insert*/) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. Static list of fields we care about - covers 99% of tables
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var REFERENCE_FIELDS = [
        'caller_id',          // incident
        'assigned_to',        // task (all subclasses)
        'opened_by',          // task
        'requested_by',       // change_request
        'requested_for',      // sc_request, sc_req_item
        'sys_created_by',     // any record (string username, not sys_id)
        'manager',            // various
        'approver',           // sysapproval_approver
        'u_owner',            // common custom owner field
        'u_business_owner'
    ];
    var GLIDE_LIST_FIELDS = [
        'watch_list',         // task watchers
        'work_notes_list'     // task work-note recipients
    ];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Filter - only act on real comments / work notes
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var element = String(current.element || '');
    if (element != 'comments' && element != 'work_notes') return;

    var tableName  = String(current.name || '');
    var recordId   = String(current.element_id || '');
    var body       = String(current.value || '').trim();
    var authorUser = String(current.sys_created_by || '');

    gs.info('[NetraNotify] start - table=' + tableName +
            ' record=' + recordId +
            ' element=' + element +
            ' author=' + authorUser +
            ' bodylen=' + body.length);

    if (!tableName || !recordId || !body) {
        gs.info('[NetraNotify] skipped - missing tableName/recordId/body');
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Open the parent record
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var parent = new GlideRecord(tableName);
    if (!parent.isValid()) {
        gs.warn('[NetraNotify] table not valid in this scope: ' + tableName);
        return;
    }
    if (!parent.get(recordId)) {
        gs.warn('[NetraNotify] record not found or not readable: ' + tableName + '/' + recordId);
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Collect every user the record references (no introspection)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var usersToNotify = {};

    REFERENCE_FIELDS.forEach(function (fieldName) {
        var raw = '';
        try { raw = String(parent.getValue(fieldName) || ''); } catch (e) { return; }
        if (!raw) return;
        // sys_created_by is a USERNAME, not a sys_id - need to resolve
        if (fieldName == 'sys_created_by') {
            var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
            u.addQuery('user_name', raw);
            u.setLimit(1);
            u.query();
            if (u.next()) { usersToNotify[String(u.sys_id)] = fieldName; }
        } else if (raw.length == 32) {
            // looks like a sys_id (32 hex chars)
            usersToNotify[raw] = fieldName;
        }
    });

    GLIDE_LIST_FIELDS.forEach(function (fieldName) {
        var raw = '';
        try { raw = String(parent.getValue(fieldName) || ''); } catch (e) { return; }
        if (!raw) return;
        raw.split(',').forEach(function (sysId) {
            sysId = sysId.trim();
            if (sysId && sysId.length == 32) usersToNotify[sysId] = fieldName;
        });
    });

    var candidateCount = 0;
    for (var ck in usersToNotify) candidateCount++;
    gs.info('[NetraNotify] candidates found: ' + candidateCount +
            ' (' + Object.keys(usersToNotify).join(',') + ')');

    if (candidateCount == 0) {
        gs.info('[NetraNotify] no user-reference fields populated on ' + tableName + '/' + recordId);
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Optional: include the author for testing visibility
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var notifyAuthor = gs.getProperty('x_196061_netra_v1.notify_author', 'false') == 'true';
    gs.info('[NetraNotify] notify_author setting = ' + notifyAuthor);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 5. Resolve author display name
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var authorDisplay = authorUser;
    var au = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    au.addQuery('user_name', authorUser);
    au.setLimit(1);
    au.query();
    if (au.next()) {
        var full = (String(au.first_name || '') + ' ' + String(au.last_name || '')).trim();
        if (full) authorDisplay = full;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Pronounceable number for spoken playback
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var num = '';
    try { num = String(parent.getValue('number') || ''); } catch (e) {}
    var spokenNum = '';
    if (num) {
        var letters = num.replace(/[^A-Z]/g, '').split('').join(' ');
        var digits  = num.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').split('').map(function (dg) {
            return ({ '0':'zero','1':'one','2':'two','3':'three','4':'four',
                       '5':'five','6':'six','7':'seven','8':'eight','9':'nine' })[dg] || dg;
        }).join(' ');
        spokenNum = (letters + ' ' + digits).trim();
    }

    var kindLabel = element == 'work_notes' ? 'work note' : 'comment';
    var tableLabel = tableName;
    try { tableLabel = String(parent.getLabel() || tableName); } catch (e) {}

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7. Enqueue notifications
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    var sentCount = 0;
    var skippedAsAuthor = 0;
    for (var userSysId in usersToNotify) {
        var fieldName = usersToNotify[userSysId];
        var user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (!user.get(userSysId)) {
            gs.info('[NetraNotify]   skipped ' + userSysId + ' (user not found)');
            continue;
        }
        var userName = String(user.user_name);
        // R21 - the shared Guest user (the public page's visitors) has no inbox
        if (userName === 'guest') { gs.info('[NetraNotify]   skipped guest (shared public user)'); continue; }

        if (userName == authorUser && !notifyAuthor) {
            skippedAsAuthor++;
            gs.info('[NetraNotify]   skipped ' + userName + ' (is author of comment, field=' + fieldName + ')');
            continue;
        }
        if (!_wantsComments(userSysId)) {
            gs.info('[NetraNotify]   skipped ' + userName + ' (no Netra pref, or comment alerts off)');
            continue;
        }
        // work notes are internal: a caller or watcher must never hear one read aloud
        if (element == 'work_notes' && !_isFulfiller(userSysId)) {
            gs.info('[NetraNotify]   skipped ' + userName + ' (work note, not a fulfiller)');
            continue;
        }

        var inserted = _enqueue(userSysId, recordId, num, spokenNum, kindLabel,
                                 body, authorDisplay, element, tableLabel);
        if (inserted) {
            sentCount++;
            gs.info('[NetraNotify]   ENQUEUED for ' + userName + ' via field=' + fieldName + ' notif_sys_id=' + inserted);
        } else {
            gs.warn('[NetraNotify]   insert FAILED for ' + userName);
        }
    }

    gs.info('[NetraNotify] DONE - ' + tableName + ' ' + recordId +
            ' candidates=' + candidateCount +
            ' notified=' + sentCount +
            ' skippedAsAuthor=' + skippedAsAuthor);

    function _enqueue(userSysId, recordId, num, spokenNum, kind, body, author, element, tableLabel) {
        var n = new GlideRecord('x_196061_netra_v1_notification');
        n.initialize();
        n.user           = userSysId;
        n.ticket_sys_id  = recordId;
        n.ticket_number  = num;
        n.kind           = element == 'work_notes' ? 'work_note' : 'comment';
        n.message        = 'New ' + kind + ' on ' + tableLabel +
                           (spokenNum ? ' ' + spokenNum : '') +
                           ' from ' + author + '. ' +
                           body.substring(0, 400) + (body.length > 400 ? '...' : '');
        n.delivered      = false;
        return String(n.insert() || '');
    }

    // booleans read back '1'/'0' through getValue on the platform
    function _off(v) { v = String(v); return v === '0' || v === 'false'; }

    function _wantsComments(userSysId) {
        var p = new GlideRecord('x_196061_netra_v1_user_pref');
        p.addQuery('user', userSysId);
        p.setLimit(1);
        p.query();
        return p.next() && !_off(p.getValue('active')) && !_off(p.getValue('watch_comments'));
    }

    function _isFulfiller(userSysId) {
        var roles = String(gs.getProperty('x_196061_netra_v1.fulfiller_roles', 'itil,admin,sn_incident_read,sn_incident_write')).replace(/\s+/g, '');
        var hr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');
        hr.addQuery('user', userSysId);
        hr.addQuery('role.name', 'IN', roles);
        hr.setLimit(1);
        hr.query();
        return hr.next();
    }

})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-09 04:41:41</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10cb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Netra Notify On Comment</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_05b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10cb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 16:50:21</sys_updated_on><template/><when>async</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=05b3da9093424710e3aef0aefaba10cb"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="DELETE"><category>general</category><client_script/><description>Interactive Monte Carlo simulation over the GRC risk register</description><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_196061_netra_v1_mc_risk_dashboard.do</endpoint><html><?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<div class="viz-root" id="mcRoot">
<style>
.viz-root {
  --surface-1: #fcfcfb; --page: #f9f9f7;
  --ink-1: #0b0b0b; --ink-2: #52514e; --ink-3: #898781;
  --grid: #e1e0d9; --axisline: #c3c2b7; --ring: rgba(11,11,11,0.10);
  --series-1: #2a78d6; --series-2: #1baf7a; --series-3: #eda100;
  --series-4: #008300; --series-5: #4a3aa7; --series-6: #e34948;
  --series-7: #e87ba4; --series-8: #eb6834;
  --demph: #c3c2b7; --area-wash: rgba(42,120,214,0.10);
  --good: #006300; --bad: #d03b3b;
  --accent-soft: rgba(42,120,214,0.12);
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink-1); background: var(--page);
  margin: 0; padding: 20px; min-height: 100vh; box-sizing: border-box;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .viz-root {
    --surface-1: #1a1a19; --page: #0d0d0d;
    --ink-1: #ffffff; --ink-2: #c3c2b7; --ink-3: #898781;
    --grid: #2c2c2a; --axisline: #383835; --ring: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    --series-1: #3987e5; --series-2: #199e70; --series-3: #c98500;
    --series-4: #008300; --series-5: #9085e9; --series-6: #e66767;
    --series-7: #d55181; --series-8: #d95926;
    --demph: #52514e; --area-wash: rgba(57,135,229,0.12);
    --good: #0ca30c; --bad: #e66767;
    --accent-soft: rgba(57,135,229,0.18);
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .viz-root {
  --surface-1: #1a1a19; --page: #0d0d0d;
  --ink-1: #ffffff; --ink-2: #c3c2b7; --ink-3: #898781;
  --grid: #2c2c2a; --axisline: #383835; --ring: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  --series-1: #3987e5; --series-2: #199e70; --series-3: #c98500;
  --series-4: #008300; --series-5: #9085e9; --series-6: #e66767;
  --series-7: #d55181; --series-8: #d95926;
  --demph: #52514e; --area-wash: rgba(57,135,229,0.12);
  --good: #0ca30c; --bad: #e66767;
  --accent-soft: rgba(57,135,229,0.18);
}
:root[data-theme="light"] .viz-root {
  --surface-1: #fcfcfb; --page: #f9f9f7;
  --ink-1: #0b0b0b; --ink-2: #52514e; --ink-3: #898781;
  --grid: #e1e0d9; --axisline: #c3c2b7; --ring: rgba(11,11,11,0.10);
  --series-1: #2a78d6; --series-2: #1baf7a; --series-3: #eda100;
  --series-4: #008300; --series-5: #4a3aa7; --series-6: #e34948;
  --series-7: #e87ba4; --series-8: #eb6834;
  --demph: #c3c2b7; --area-wash: rgba(42,120,214,0.10);
  --good: #006300; --bad: #d03b3b;
  --accent-soft: rgba(42,120,214,0.12);
}
.viz-root * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.mc-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.mc-header h1 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0; }
.mc-sub { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12.5px; }
.mc-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 18px;
  background: var(--surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 14px; margin: 12px 0 16px 0; }
.ctl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.ctl label { white-space: nowrap; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; }
.seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 5px 10px;
  font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; }
.seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--ring); }
.seg button.on { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink-1); font-weight: 600; }
.ctl input[type="number"] { width: 84px; font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-1);
  background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 7px; }
.ctl input[type="range"] { width: 110px; accent-color: var(--series-1); }
.ctl .mult { min-width: 44px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-1); font-weight: 600; }
.btn { border: 1px solid var(--ring); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink-1);
  border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.btn.primary { background: var(--series-1); border-color: var(--series-1); color: #ffffff; }
.btn[disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }
.mc-progress { flex: 1 1 120px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--accent-soft);
  overflow: hidden; min-width: 90px; }
.mc-progress > div { height: 100%; width: 0%; background: var(--series-1); border-radius: 3px;
  transition: width 100ms linear; }
.tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tile { background: var(--surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; }
.tile .t-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.tile .t-value { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.15; }
.tile.hero .t-value { font-size: 48px; }
.tile .t-delta { font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; font-weight: 600; }
.tile .t-delta.worse { color: var(--bad); }
.tile .t-delta.better { color: var(--good); }
.tile .t-delta.flat { color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 400; }
.tile .t-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 3px; }
.grid2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(330px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
figure.card { background: var(--surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 14px 0; padding: 14px 14px 10px 14px; position: relative; min-width: 0; }
figure.card figcaption { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
figure.card .c-title { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; }
figure.card .c-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); }
.tbl-toggle { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--series-1); font: inherit;
  font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; padding: 2px 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.chart-box { position: relative; }
.chart-box svg { display: block; width: 100%; }
.chart-box.faded svg { opacity: 0.45; }
.axis-text { font-size: 10.5px; fill: var(--ink-3); }
.dl-text { font-size: 11px; fill: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 600; }
.mc-tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: var(--surface-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
  padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12px; display: none; z-index: 30; min-width: 130px; max-width: 280px; }
.mc-tip .tip-h { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.mc-tip .tip-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin-top: 2px; }
.mc-tip .tip-key { width: 12px; height: 0; border-top: 3px solid var(--series-1); border-radius: 2px; flex: none; align-self: center; }
.mc-tip .tip-val { font-weight: 650; }
.mc-tip .tip-lbl { color: var(--ink-2); }
.data-table { display: none; overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 6px; }
.data-table.show { display: block; }
.data-table table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 12px; }
.data-table th { text-align: left; color: var(--ink-2); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid);
  padding: 4px 10px 4px 0; white-space: nowrap; }
.data-table td { padding: 4px 10px 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-2); margin: 4px 0 2px 0; }
.legend .lg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.legend .sw { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; flex: none; }
.risk-card { background: var(--surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; }
.risk-card h2 { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0 0 2px 0; }
.risk-card .c-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.risk-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
table.risks { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 12.5px; min-width: 900px; }
table.risks th { text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 11.5px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid); padding: 6px 10px 6px 0; white-space: nowrap; }
table.risks th.num, table.risks td.num { text-align: right; }
table.risks td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grid); padding: 5px 10px 5px 0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
table.risks td.name { max-width: 250px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
table.risks input[type="number"] { width: 98px; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-1);
  background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 6px; text-align: right; }
table.risks select { font: inherit; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-1); background: var(--page);
  border: 1px solid var(--ring); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 4px; }
table.risks tr.off td { opacity: 0.45; }
table.risks .catdot { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 6px; }
.bar-hit { fill: transparent; cursor: pointer; }
.bar-hit:focus { outline: none; }
.mc-foot { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
</style>

<div class="mc-header">
  <h1>Monte Carlo Risk Simulation</h1>
  <span class="mc-sub" id="mcMeta">initializing…</span>
</div>

<div class="mc-controls" role="group" aria-label="Simulation controls">
  <div class="ctl"><label>Trials</label>
    <span class="seg" id="trialSeg">
      <button type="button" data-trials="1000">1k</button>
      <button type="button" data-trials="10000" class="on">10k</button>
      <button type="button" data-trials="50000">50k</button>
      <button type="button" data-trials="100000">100k</button>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="seedIn">Seed</label>
    <input type="number" id="seedIn" value="42" step="1" /></div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="freqStress">Frequency stress</label>
    <input type="range" id="freqStress" min="-2" max="2" step="0.1" value="0" />
    <span class="mult" id="freqStressVal">×1.0</span></div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="sevStress">Severity stress</label>
    <input type="range" id="sevStress" min="-2" max="2" step="0.1" value="0" />
    <span class="mult" id="sevStressVal">×1.0</span></div>
  <button type="button" class="btn primary" id="runBtn">Re-run</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn" id="resetBtn">Reset scenario</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn" id="liveBtn" style="display:none">Reload live risks</button>
  <div class="mc-progress" aria-hidden="true"><div id="progBar"></div></div>
</div>

<div class="tiles" id="tiles"></div>

<div class="grid2">
  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Annual loss distribution</div>
        <div class="c-sub" id="histSub"></div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="histTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="histBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="histTable"></div>
  </figure>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Loss exceedance curve</div>
        <div class="c-sub">Probability that annual loss meets or exceeds x — log loss scale</div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="lecTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="lecBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="lecTable"></div>
  </figure>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Top risk drivers</div>
        <div class="c-sub">Expected annual loss by risk, colored by entity</div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="torTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="legend" id="torLegend"></div>
    <div class="chart-box" id="torBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="torTable"></div>
  </figure>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Convergence of expected annual loss</div>
        <div class="c-sub">Running mean as trials accumulate — flat means enough trials</div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="convTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="convBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="convTable"></div>
  </figure>
</div>

<div class="risk-card">
  <h2>Risk register — scenario inputs</h2>
  <div class="c-sub">Edit frequency and per-event impact estimates or toggle risks out of the portfolio; the simulation re-runs automatically. Stress sliders above multiply every enabled risk.</div>
  <div class="risk-wrap"><table class="risks">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>On</th><th>Risk</th><th>Entity</th>
      <th class="num">Freq min</th><th class="num">Freq ML</th><th class="num">Freq max</th>
      <th class="num">Impact min</th><th class="num">Impact ML</th><th class="num">Impact max</th>
      <th>Severity</th>
      <th class="num">EAL</th><th class="num">Share</th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody id="riskRows"></tbody>
  </table></div>
</div>

<div class="mc-foot" id="mcFoot"></div>

    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280), H = 240;
    var padL = 44, padR = 12, padT = 10, padB = 30;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);

    var clip = percentileSorted(r.sorted, 99);
    if (clip <= 0) { clip = 1; }
    var BINS = 36;
    var counts = new Array(BINS); var bi;
    for (bi = 0; bi < BINS; bi++) { counts[bi] = 0; }
    var over = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < r.sorted.length; i++) {
      var v = r.sorted[i];
      if (v > clip) { over++; continue; }
      var b = Math.min(BINS - 1, Math.floor(BINS * v / clip));
      counts[b]++;
    }
    var maxC = 1;
    for (bi = 0; bi < BINS; bi++) { if (counts[bi] > maxC) { maxC = counts[bi]; } }
    byId("histSub").textContent = fmtInt(r.trials) + " simulated years · binned to P99 (" +
      fmtMoney(clip) + "); " + fmtPct(over / r.trials) + " of years beyond";

    var plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;
    var yTicks = niceTicks(0, maxC, 4);
    yTicks.forEach(function (t) {
      var y = padT + plotH - plotH * t / maxC;
      el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "var(--grid)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL - 6, y: y + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtInt(t) }, svg);
    });
    var xTicks = niceTicks(0, clip, 5);
    xTicks.forEach(function (t) {
      var x = padL + plotW * t / clip;
      el("text", { x: x, y: H - 10, "text-anchor": "middle", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtMoney(t) }, svg);
    });
    el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: padT + plotH, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);

    var bw = plotW / BINS;
    var barW = Math.min(bw - 2, 24);
    for (bi = 0; bi < BINS; bi++) {
      var h = plotH * counts[bi] / maxC;
      if (h > 0 && h < 1) { h = 1; }
      var x0 = padL + bi * bw + (bw - barW) / 2;
      var y0 = padT + plotH - h;
      var rad = Math.min(4, barW / 2, h);
      el("path", {
        d: "M" + x0 + "," + (y0 + h) + " L" + x0 + "," + (y0 + rad) +
           " Q" + x0 + "," + y0 + " " + (x0 + rad) + "," + y0 +
           " L" + (x0 + barW - rad) + "," + y0 +
           " Q" + (x0 + barW) + "," + y0 + " " + (x0 + barW) + "," + (y0 + rad) +
           " L" + (x0 + barW) + "," + (y0 + h) + " Z",
        style: "fill:var(--series-1)"
      }, svg);
    }
    for (bi = 0; bi < BINS; bi++) {
      (function (bi) {
        var lo = clip * bi / BINS, hi2 = clip * (bi + 1) / BINS;
        var hit = el("rect", {
          x: padL + bi * bw, y: padT, width: bw, height: plotH,
          "class": "bar-hit", tabindex: 0,
          "aria-label": fmtMoney(lo) + " to " + fmtMoney(hi2) + ": " + fmtInt(counts[bi]) + " years"
        }, svg);
        function show(evt) {
          var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
          var px = evt && evt.clientX ? evt.clientX - rect.left : padL + bi * bw + bw / 2;
          var py = evt && evt.clientY ? evt.clientY - rect.top : padT + 20;
          tip.show([
            { value: fmtInt(counts[bi]) + " years", label: fmtPct(counts[bi] / r.trials), color: getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue("--series-1") }
          ], px, py, fmtMoney(lo) + " – " + fmtMoney(hi2));
        }
        hit.addEventListener("pointermove", show);
        hit.addEventListener("focus", function () { show(null); });
        hit.addEventListener("pointerleave", tip.hide);
        hit.addEventListener("blur", tip.hide);
      })(bi);
    }

    var tbl = byId("histTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Loss bin", "Years", "Share"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    for (bi = 0; bi < BINS; bi++) {
      if (counts[bi] === 0) { continue; }
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoney(clip * bi / BINS) + " – " + fmtMoney(clip * (bi + 1) / BINS);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtInt(counts[bi]);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtPct(counts[bi] / r.trials);
    }
    if (over > 0) {
      var orow = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, orow).textContent = "beyond " + fmtMoney(clip);
      hel("td", null, orow).textContent = fmtInt(over);
      hel("td", null, orow).textContent = fmtPct(over / r.trials);
    }
  }

  // ---------- loss exceedance curve ----------
  function renderLec(r) {
    var box = byId("lecBox");
    clear(box);
    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280), H = 240;
    var padL = 44, padR = 14, padT = 10, padB = 30;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);
    var plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;

    var sorted = r.sorted;
    var minPos = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) { if (sorted[i] > 0) { minPos = sorted[i]; break; } }
    if (minPos === 0) { minPos = 1; }
    var maxV = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
    if (maxV <= minPos) { maxV = minPos * 10; }
    var logMin = Math.log(minPos), logMax = Math.log(maxV);
    function xOf(v) { return padL + plotW * (Math.log(v) - logMin) / (logMax - logMin); }
    function exceed(v) {
      var lo = 0, hi = sorted.length;
      while (lo < hi) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (sorted[mid] < v) { lo = mid + 1; } else { hi = mid; } }
      return (sorted.length - lo) / sorted.length;
    }
    var pts = [];
    var STEPS = 90;
    for (var s = 0; s <= STEPS; s++) {
      var v = Math.exp(logMin + (logMax - logMin) * s / STEPS);
      pts.push([v, exceed(v)]);
    }
    var maxP = pts[0][1];
    function yOf(p) { return padT + plotH * (1 - (maxP > 0 ? p / maxP : 0)); }

    var pTicks = niceTicks(0, maxP, 4);
    pTicks.forEach(function (t) {
      var y = yOf(t);
      el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "var(--grid)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL - 6, y: y + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtPct(t, 0) }, svg);
    });
    var decade = Math.pow(10, Math.ceil(Math.log(minPos) / Math.LN10));
    for (var d2 = decade; d2 <= maxV * 1.0001; d2 *= 10) {
      var xd = xOf(d2);
      el("text", { x: xd, y: H - 10, "text-anchor": "middle", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtMoney(d2) }, svg);
    }
    el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: padT + plotH, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);

    var dArea = "M" + xOf(pts[0][0]) + "," + (padT + plotH);
    var dLine = "";
    pts.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      var cmd = (idx === 0 ? "M" : "L");
      dLine += cmd + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(p[1]).toFixed(1);
      dArea += "L" + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(p[1]).toFixed(1);
    });
    dArea += "L" + xOf(pts[pts.length - 1][0]).toFixed(1) + "," + (padT + plotH) + " Z";
    el("path", { d: dArea, style: "fill:var(--area-wash)" }, svg);
    el("path", { d: dLine, style: "stroke:var(--series-1);fill:none", "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round" }, svg);

    [[r.var95, "VaR 95", -9], [r.var99, "VaR 99", 18]].forEach(function (mark) {
      if (mark[0] <= minPos || mark[0] > maxV) { return; }
      var mx = xOf(mark[0]), my = yOf(exceed(mark[0]));
      el("circle", { cx: mx, cy: my, r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2 }, svg);
      var anchor = mx > padL + plotW - 34 ? "end" : "middle";
      el("text", { x: mx, y: my + mark[2], "text-anchor": anchor, "class": "dl-text", text: mark[1] }, svg);
    });

    var cross = el("line", { x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: padT, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var dot = el("circle", { r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var hover = el("rect", { x: padL, y: padT, width: plotW, height: plotH, fill: "transparent" }, svg);
    hover.addEventListener("pointermove", function (evt) {
      var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = evt.clientX - rect.left;
      if (px < padL) { px = padL; }
      if (px > padL + plotW) { px = padL + plotW; }
      var v = Math.exp(logMin + (logMax - logMin) * (px - padL) / plotW);
      var p = exceed(v);
      cross.setAttribute("x1", px); cross.setAttribute("x2", px); cross.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      dot.setAttribute("cx", px); dot.setAttribute("cy", yOf(p)); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      tip.show([
        { value: fmtPct(p), label: "chance annual loss ≥ " + fmtMoney(v), color: getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue("--series-1") },
        { value: p > 0 ? "1-in-" + fmtInt(Math.round(1 / Math.max(p, 1e-6))) : "—", label: "return period (years)" }
      ], px, evt.clientY - rect.top);
    });
    hover.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
      cross.setAttribute("opacity", 0); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 0); tip.hide();
    });

    var tbl = byId("lecTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Annual loss ≥", "Probability", "Return period"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    [0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01].forEach(function (p) {
      var v = percentileSorted(sorted, 100 * (1 - p));
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(v);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtPct(p, 0);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = "1-in-" + Math.round(1 / p) + " years";
    });
  }

  // ---------- tornado ----------
  function renderTornado(r) {
    var box = byId("torBox");
    clear(box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);
    var TOP = 10;
    var shown = r.per.slice(0, TOP);
    var rest = r.per.slice(TOP);
    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280);
    var rowH = 26, padL = 10, padR = 74, padT = 4, padB = 6;
    var labelW = Math.min(230, Math.max(140, W * 0.36));
    var rows = shown.length + (rest.length > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    var H = padT + padB + rows * rowH;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var plotW = W - padL - labelW - padR;
    var maxE = shown.length > 0 ? shown[0].eal : 1;
    var restSum = rest.reduce(function (a, p) { return a + p.eal; }, 0);
    if (restSum > maxE) { maxE = restSum; }

    var legend = byId("torLegend");
    clear(legend);
    var seen = [];
    r.per.forEach(function (p) {
      var c = p.ref.category;
      if (seen.indexOf(c) === -1) { seen.push(c); }
    });
    seen.forEach(function (c) {
      var lg = hel("span", "lg", legend);
      var sw = hel("span", "sw", lg);
      sw.style.background = catColor[c] || "var(--demph)";
      lg.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c || "uncategorized"));
    });

    var maxChars = Math.max(8, Math.floor((labelW - 12) / 6.4));
    function bar(idx, name, eal, share, p95, color, cat) {
      var y = padT + idx * rowH;
      var bw = Math.max(plotW * eal / maxE, 1.5);
      var bh = 16;
      var by = y + (rowH - bh) / 2;
      var lbl = el("text", { x: padL + labelW - 8, y: y + rowH / 2 + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: name.length > maxChars ? name.slice(0, maxChars - 1) + "…" : name }, svg);
      lbl.style.fill = "var(--ink-2)";
      var rad = Math.min(4, bw);
      el("path", {
        d: "M" + (padL + labelW) + "," + by +
           " L" + (padL + labelW + bw - rad) + "," + by +
           " Q" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + by + " " + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + rad) +
           " L" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + bh - rad) +
           " Q" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + bh) + " " + (padL + labelW + bw - rad) + "," + (by + bh) +
           " L" + (padL + labelW) + "," + (by + bh) + " Z",
        style: "fill:" + color
      }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL + labelW + bw + 6, y: y + rowH / 2 + 3.5, "class": "dl-text", text: fmtMoney(eal) }, svg);
      var hit = el("rect", { x: 0, y: y, width: W, height: rowH, "class": "bar-hit", tabindex: 0,
        "aria-label": name + ": " + fmtMoney(eal) + " expected annual loss, " + fmtPct(share) }, svg);
      function show(evt) {
        var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
        var px = evt && evt.clientX ? evt.clientX - rect.left : padL + labelW + 40;
        var py = evt && evt.clientY ? evt.clientY - rect.top : y;
        var rowsData = [
          { value: fmtMoney(eal), label: "expected annual loss", color: color.indexOf("var(") === 0 ? getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue(color.slice(4, -1)) : color },
          { value: fmtPct(share), label: "of portfolio EAL" }
        ];
        if (p95 !== null && p95 !== undefined) {
          rowsData.push({ value: fmtMoney(p95), label: "P95 annual loss" });
        }
        tip.show(rowsData, px, py, cat ? name + " · " + cat : name);
      }
      hit.addEventListener("pointermove", show);
      hit.addEventListener("focus", function () { show(null); });
      hit.addEventListener("pointerleave", tip.hide);
      hit.addEventListener("blur", tip.hide);
    }

    shown.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      bar(idx, p.ref.name, p.eal, p.share, p.p95, catColor[p.ref.category] || "var(--demph)", p.ref.category);
    });
    if (rest.length > 0) {
      var restShare = r.per.reduce(function (a, p2) { return a + p2.share; }, 0);
      var shownShare = shown.reduce(function (a, p2) { return a + p2.share; }, 0);
      bar(shown.length, "Other (" + rest.length + " risks)", restSum, restShare - shownShare, null, "var(--demph)", "");
    }

    var tbl = byId("torTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Risk", "Entity", "EAL", "Share", "P95 annual loss"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    r.per.forEach(function (p) {
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.ref.name;
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.ref.category;
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(p.eal);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtPct(p.share);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.p95 !== null ? fmtMoneyFull(p.p95) : "—";
    });
  }

  // ---------- convergence ----------
  function renderConv(r) {
    var box = byId("convBox");
    clear(box);
    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280), H = 240;
    var padL = 52, padR = 60, padT = 12, padB = 30;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);
    var plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;
    var conv = r.conv;
    if (conv.length < 2) { return; }
    var minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    var start = Math.min(4, conv.length - 1);
    for (var i = start; i < conv.length; i++) {
      if (conv[i][1] < minY) { minY = conv[i][1]; }
      if (conv[i][1] > maxY) { maxY = conv[i][1]; }
    }
    var padY = (maxY - minY) * 0.25 + 1;
    minY -= padY; maxY += padY;
    if (minY < 0) { minY = 0; }
    function xOf(t) { return padL + plotW * t / r.trials; }
    function yOf(v) { return padT + plotH * (1 - (v - minY) / (maxY - minY)); }

    niceTicks(minY, maxY, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      var y = yOf(t);
      if (y < padT || y > padT + plotH) { return; }
      el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "var(--grid)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL - 6, y: y + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtMoney(t) }, svg);
    });
    niceTicks(0, r.trials, 5).forEach(function (t) {
      if (t === 0) { return; }
      el("text", { x: xOf(t), y: H - 10, "text-anchor": "middle", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtInt(t) }, svg);
    });
    el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: padT + plotH, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);

    var d = "";
    conv.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      d += (idx === 0 ? "M" : "L") + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(Math.min(Math.max(p[1], minY), maxY)).toFixed(1);
    });
    el("path", { d: d, style: "stroke:var(--series-1);fill:none", "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round" }, svg);
    var last = conv[conv.length - 1];
    el("circle", { cx: xOf(last[0]), cy: yOf(last[1]), r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2 }, svg);
    el("text", { x: xOf(last[0]) + 8, y: yOf(last[1]) + 3.5, "class": "dl-text", text: fmtMoney(last[1]) }, svg);

    var cross = el("line", { x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: padT, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var dot = el("circle", { r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var hover = el("rect", { x: padL, y: padT, width: plotW, height: plotH, fill: "transparent" }, svg);
    hover.addEventListener("pointermove", function (evt) {
      var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = evt.clientX - rect.left;
      var t = (px - padL) / plotW * r.trials;
      var best = conv[0];
      for (var i2 = 0; i2 < conv.length; i2++) {
        if (Math.abs(conv[i2][0] - t) < Math.abs(best[0] - t)) { best = conv[i2]; }
      }
      cross.setAttribute("x1", xOf(best[0])); cross.setAttribute("x2", xOf(best[0])); cross.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      dot.setAttribute("cx", xOf(best[0])); dot.setAttribute("cy", yOf(best[1])); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      tip.show([
        { value: fmtMoney(best[1]), label: "running mean EAL", color: getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue("--series-1") }
      ], xOf(best[0]), evt.clientY - rect.top, "after " + fmtInt(best[0]) + " trials");
    });
    hover.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
      cross.setAttribute("opacity", 0); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 0); tip.hide();
    });

    var tbl = byId("convTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Trials", "Running mean EAL"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    var stride = Math.max(1, Math.floor(conv.length / 10));
    for (var i3 = 0; i3 < conv.length; i3 += stride) {
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtInt(conv[i3][0]);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(conv[i3][1]);
    }
  }

  // ---------- risk table ----------
  function renderRiskTable(r) {
    var body = byId("riskRows");
    clear(body);
    var byId2 = {};
    if (r) {
      r.per.forEach(function (p) { byId2[p.ref.sys_id || p.ref.name] = p; });
    }
    scenario.forEach(function (risk) {
      var row = hel("tr", risk.enabled ? null : "off", body);
      var tdOn = hel("td", null, row);
      var cb = document.createElement("input");
      cb.type = "checkbox"; cb.checked = risk.enabled;
      cb.addEventListener("change", function () { risk.enabled = cb.checked; scheduleRun(); });
      tdOn.appendChild(cb);
      var tdName = hel("td", "name", row);
      tdName.textContent = risk.name;
      tdName.title = (risk.number ? risk.number + " — " : "") + risk.name;
      var tdCat = hel("td", null, row);
      var dotSpan = hel("span", "catdot", tdCat);
      dotSpan.style.background = catColor[risk.category] || "var(--demph)";
      tdCat.appendChild(document.createTextNode(risk.category || "—"));

      [["fmin", 0.01], ["fml", 0.01], ["fmax", 0.01], ["imin", 1000], ["iml", 1000], ["imax", 1000]].forEach(function (f) {
        var td = hel("td", "num", row);
        var inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = "number"; inp.min = "0"; inp.step = String(f[1]);
        inp.value = String(risk[f[0]]);
        inp.addEventListener("change", function () {
          var v = parseFloat(inp.value);
          if (!isFinite(v) || v < 0) { v = 0; inp.value = "0"; }
          risk[f[0]] = v;
          scheduleRun();
        });
        td.appendChild(inp);
      });

      var tdModel = hel("td", null, row);
      var sel = document.createElement("select");
      ["pert", "lognormal"].forEach(function (m) {
        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = m; opt.textContent = m;
        if (risk.model === m) { opt.selected = true; }
        sel.appendChild(opt);
      });
      sel.addEventListener("change", function () { risk.model = sel.value; scheduleRun(); });
      tdModel.appendChild(sel);

      var p = byId2[risk.sys_id || risk.name];
      hel("td", "num", row).textContent = risk.enabled && p ? fmtMoney(p.eal) : "—";
      hel("td", "num", row).textContent = risk.enabled && p ? fmtPct(p.share) : "—";
    });
  }

  // ---------- orchestration ----------
  var pendingTimer = null;
  function scheduleRun() {
    if (pendingTimer) { clearTimeout(pendingTimer); }
    pendingTimer = setTimeout(run, 450);
  }

  function renderAll(r) {
    renderTiles(r);
    renderHist(r);
    renderLec(r);
    renderTornado(r);
    renderConv(r);
    renderRiskTable(r);
    var stressed = freqMult !== 1 || sevMult !== 1;
    byId("mcFoot").textContent =
      "Source: " + dataSource + " · " + scenario.filter(function (x) { return x.enabled; }).length +
      " of " + scenario.length + " risks enabled · seed " + r.seed +
      (stressed ? " · stress freq ×" + freqMult.toFixed(2) + ", severity ×" + sevMult.toFixed(2) : "") +
      " · Engine: Poisson frequency × PERT/lognormal severity, seeded Mulberry32 RNG · " +
      "Generated " + DATA.generated_at + " from " + DATA.instance;
  }

  function run() {
    runSimulation(function (result) {
      lastResult = result;
      if (!baseline && freqMult === 1 && sevMult === 1) { baseline = result; }
      renderAll(result);
    });
  }

  // ---------- controls ----------
  function wireControls() {
    byId("trialSeg").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        byId("trialSeg").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
        b.classList.add("on");
        trials = parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-trials"), 10);
        scheduleRun();
      });
    });
    byId("seedIn").addEventListener("change", function () {
      var v = parseInt(byId("seedIn").value, 10);
      seed = isFinite(v) ? v : 42;
      scheduleRun();
    });
    function wireStress(id, valId, setter) {
      byId(id).addEventListener("input", function () {
        var mult = Math.pow(2, parseFloat(byId(id).value));
        setter(mult);
        byId(valId).textContent = "×" + mult.toFixed(mult < 1 ? 2 : 1);
        scheduleRun();
      });
    }
    wireStress("freqStress", "freqStressVal", function (m) { freqMult = m; });
    wireStress("sevStress", "sevStressVal", function (m) { sevMult = m; });
    byId("runBtn").addEventListener("click", run);
    byId("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
      initScenario();
      freqMult = 1; sevMult = 1;
      byId("freqStress").value = "0"; byId("sevStress").value = "0";
      byId("freqStressVal").textContent = "×1.0"; byId("sevStressVal").textContent = "×1.0";
      baseline = null;
      run();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".tbl-toggle").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var t = byId(b.getAttribute("data-table"));
        var showing = t.classList.toggle("show");
        b.textContent = showing ? "Chart view" : "Table view";
      });
    });
    var resizeTimer = null;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      if (resizeTimer) { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); }
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (lastResult) { renderAll(lastResult); } }, 200);
    });
  }

  // ---------- optional live reload from the instance ----------
  function num(rec, name) {
    var v = rec[name];
    if (v && typeof v === "object") { v = v.value; }
    var f = parseFloat(v);
    return isFinite(f) && f > 0 ? f : null;
  }
  function disp(rec, name) {
    var v = rec[name];
    if (v && typeof v === "object") { return String(v.display_value || ""); }
    return v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v);
  }
  function mapLive(records) {
    var out = [];
    records.forEach(function (rec) {
      var fml = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_most_likely");
      var iml = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_most_likely");
      var model = "pert";
      var fmin, fmax, imin, imax;
      if (!fml || !iml) {
        var aro = num(rec, "residual_aro") || num(rec, "inherent_aro");
        var sle = num(rec, "residual_sle") || num(rec, "inherent_sle");
        if (!aro || !sle) { return; }
        fml = aro; fmin = aro; fmax = aro;
        iml = sle; imin = sle * 0.5; imax = sle * 2.5;
        model = "lognormal";
      } else {
        fmin = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_min") || fml;
        fmax = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_max") || fml;
        imin = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_min") || iml * 0.5;
        imax = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_max") || iml * 2.5;
      }
      out.push({
        sys_id: disp(rec, "sys_id") || (rec.sys_id && rec.sys_id.value) || rec.sys_id,
        number: disp(rec, "number"),
        name: disp(rec, "short_description") || disp(rec, "number") || "unnamed risk",
        category: disp(rec, "profile") || "uncategorized",
        freq_min: fmin, freq_ml: fml, freq_max: fmax,
        imp_min: imin, imp_ml: iml, imp_max: imax,
        model: model
      });
    });
    return out;
  }
  function tryLive() {
    var host = window.location.hostname || "";
    if (host.indexOf("service-now.com") === -1) { return; }
    var btn = byId("liveBtn");
    btn.style.display = "";
    function reload() {
      btn.disabled = true;
      var headers = { "Accept": "application/json" };
      if (window.g_ck) { headers["X-UserToken"] = window.g_ck; }
      fetch("/api/now/table/sn_risk_risk?sysparm_display_value=all&sysparm_limit=500", { headers: headers, credentials: "same-origin" })
        .then(function (resp) {
          if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
          return resp.json();
        })
        .then(function (json) {
          var mapped = mapLive(json.result || []);
          if (mapped.length === 0) { throw new Error("no readable risks (check GRC roles)"); }
          DATA.risks = mapped;
          dataSource = "live sn_risk_risk (" + mapped.length + " risks)";
          byId("mcMeta").textContent = mapped.length + " risks · live from this instance";
          initScenario();
          baseline = null;
          run();
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          dataSource = "embedded snapshot (live fetch failed: " + err.message + ")";
          if (lastResult) { renderAll(lastResult); }
        })
        .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
    }
    btn.addEventListener("click", reload);
    reload();
  }

  // ---------- boot ----------
  function boot() {
    if (!DATA || !DATA.risks || DATA.risks.length === 0) {
      byId("mcMeta").textContent = "no risk data embedded";
      return;
    }
    dataSource = "embedded snapshot (" + DATA.risks.length + " risks)";
    byId("mcMeta").textContent = DATA.risks.length + " risks · snapshot " + DATA.generated_at;
    initScenario();
    wireControls();
    run();
    tryLive();
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  } else { boot(); }
})();
//]]>
</script>
</div>

</j:jelly>

.mc-progress { flex: 1 1 120px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--accent-soft);

</style>

<div class="mc-header">
  <h1>Monte Carlo Risk Simulation</h1>

</div>

<div class="mc-controls" role="group" aria-label="Simulation controls">

      <button type="button" data-trials="10000" class="on">10k</button>
      <button type="button" data-trials="50000">50k</button>
      <button type="button" data-trials="100000">100k</button>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="seedIn">Seed</label>
    <input type="number" id="seedIn" value="42" step="1" /></div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="freqStress">Frequency stress</label>
    <input type="range" id="freqStress" min="-2" max="2" step="0.1" value="0" />
    <span class="mult" id="freqStressVal">×1.0</span></div>
  <div class="ctl"><label for="sevStress">Severity stress</label>
    <input type="range" id="sevStress" min="-2" max="2" step="0.1" value="0" />
    <span class="mult" id="sevStressVal">×1.0</span></div>
  <button type="button" class="btn primary" id="runBtn">Re-run</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn" id="resetBtn">Reset scenario</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn" id="liveBtn" style="display:none">Reload live risks</button>
  <div class="mc-progress" aria-hidden="true"><div id="progBar"></div></div>
</div>

<div class="tiles" id="tiles"></div>

<div class="grid2">
  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Annual loss distribution</div>
        <div class="c-sub" id="histSub"></div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="histTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="histBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="histTable"></div>
  </figure>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Loss exceedance curve</div>
        <div class="c-sub">Probability that annual loss meets or exceeds x — log loss scale</div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="lecTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="lecBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="lecTable"></div>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Top risk drivers</div>

    <div class="legend" id="torLegend"></div>

    <div class="data-table" id="torTable"></div>
  </figure>

  <figure class="card">
    <figcaption>
      <div><div class="c-title">Convergence of expected annual loss</div>
        <div class="c-sub">Running mean as trials accumulate — flat means enough trials</div></div>
      <button type="button" class="tbl-toggle" data-table="convTable">Table view</button>
    </figcaption>
    <div class="chart-box" id="convBox"></div>
    <div class="data-table" id="convTable"></div>
  </figure>
</div>

<div class="risk-card">
  <h2>Risk register — scenario inputs</h2>
  <div class="c-sub">Edit frequency and per-event impact estimates or toggle risks out of the portfolio; the simulation re-runs automatically. Stress sliders above multiply every enabled risk.</div>
  <div class="risk-wrap"><table class="risks">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>On</th><th>Risk</th><th>Entity</th>
      <th class="num">Freq min</th><th class="num">Freq ML</th><th class="num">Freq max</th>
