    var sorted = r.sorted;
    var minPos = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) { if (sorted[i] > 0) { minPos = sorted[i]; break; } }
    if (minPos === 0) { minPos = 1; }
    var maxV = sorted[sorted.length - 1];
    if (maxV <= minPos) { maxV = minPos * 10; }
    var logMin = Math.log(minPos), logMax = Math.log(maxV);
    function xOf(v) { return padL + plotW * (Math.log(v) - logMin) / (logMax - logMin); }
    function exceed(v) {
      var lo = 0, hi = sorted.length;
      while (lo < hi) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (sorted[mid] < v) { lo = mid + 1; } else { hi = mid; } }
      return (sorted.length - lo) / sorted.length;
    }
    var pts = [];
    var STEPS = 90;
    for (var s = 0; s <= STEPS; s++) {
      var v = Math.exp(logMin + (logMax - logMin) * s / STEPS);
      pts.push([v, exceed(v)]);
    }
    var maxP = pts[0][1];
    function yOf(p) { return padT + plotH * (1 - (maxP > 0 ? p / maxP : 0)); }

    var pTicks = niceTicks(0, maxP, 4);
    pTicks.forEach(function (t) {
      var y = yOf(t);
      el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "var(--grid)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL - 6, y: y + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtPct(t, 0) }, svg);
    });
    var decade = Math.pow(10, Math.ceil(Math.log(minPos) / Math.LN10));
    for (var d2 = decade; d2 <= maxV * 1.0001; d2 *= 10) {
      var xd = xOf(d2);
      el("text", { x: xd, y: H - 10, "text-anchor": "middle", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtMoney(d2) }, svg);
    }
    el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: padT + plotH, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);

    var dArea = "M" + xOf(pts[0][0]) + "," + (padT + plotH);
    var dLine = "";
    pts.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      var cmd = (idx === 0 ? "M" : "L");
      dLine += cmd + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(p[1]).toFixed(1);
      dArea += "L" + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(p[1]).toFixed(1);
    });
    dArea += "L" + xOf(pts[pts.length - 1][0]).toFixed(1) + "," + (padT + plotH) + " Z";
    el("path", { d: dArea, style: "fill:var(--area-wash)" }, svg);
    el("path", { d: dLine, style: "stroke:var(--series-1);fill:none", "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round" }, svg);

    [[r.var95, "VaR 95", -9], [r.var99, "VaR 99", 18]].forEach(function (mark) {
      if (mark[0] <= minPos || mark[0] > maxV) { return; }
      var mx = xOf(mark[0]), my = yOf(exceed(mark[0]));
      el("circle", { cx: mx, cy: my, r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2 }, svg);
      var anchor = mx > padL + plotW - 34 ? "end" : "middle";
      el("text", { x: mx, y: my + mark[2], "text-anchor": anchor, "class": "dl-text", text: mark[1] }, svg);
    });

    var cross = el("line", { x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: padT, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var dot = el("circle", { r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var hover = el("rect", { x: padL, y: padT, width: plotW, height: plotH, fill: "transparent" }, svg);
    hover.addEventListener("pointermove", function (evt) {
      var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = evt.clientX - rect.left;
      if (px < padL) { px = padL; }
      if (px > padL + plotW) { px = padL + plotW; }
      var v = Math.exp(logMin + (logMax - logMin) * (px - padL) / plotW);
      var p = exceed(v);
      cross.setAttribute("x1", px); cross.setAttribute("x2", px); cross.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      dot.setAttribute("cx", px); dot.setAttribute("cy", yOf(p)); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      tip.show([
        { value: fmtPct(p), label: "chance annual loss ≥ " + fmtMoney(v), color: getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue("--series-1") },
        { value: p > 0 ? "1-in-" + fmtInt(Math.round(1 / Math.max(p, 1e-6))) : "—", label: "return period (years)" }
      ], px, evt.clientY - rect.top);
    });
    hover.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
      cross.setAttribute("opacity", 0); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 0); tip.hide();
    });

    var tbl = byId("lecTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Annual loss ≥", "Probability", "Return period"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    [0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01].forEach(function (p) {
      var v = percentileSorted(sorted, 100 * (1 - p));
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(v);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtPct(p, 0);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = "1-in-" + Math.round(1 / p) + " years";
    });
  }

  // ---------- tornado ----------
  function renderTornado(r) {
    var box = byId("torBox");
    clear(box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);
    var TOP = 10;
    var shown = r.per.slice(0, TOP);
    var rest = r.per.slice(TOP);
    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280);
    var rowH = 26, padL = 10, padR = 74, padT = 4, padB = 6;
    var labelW = Math.min(230, Math.max(140, W * 0.36));
    var rows = shown.length + (rest.length > 0 ? 1 : 0);
    var H = padT + padB + rows * rowH;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var plotW = W - padL - labelW - padR;
    var maxE = shown.length > 0 ? shown[0].eal : 1;
    var restSum = rest.reduce(function (a, p) { return a + p.eal; }, 0);
    if (restSum > maxE) { maxE = restSum; }

    var legend = byId("torLegend");
    clear(legend);
    var seen = [];
    r.per.forEach(function (p) {
      var c = p.ref.category;
      if (seen.indexOf(c) === -1) { seen.push(c); }
    });
    seen.forEach(function (c) {
      var lg = hel("span", "lg", legend);
      var sw = hel("span", "sw", lg);
      sw.style.background = catColor[c] || "var(--demph)";
      lg.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c || "uncategorized"));
    });

    var maxChars = Math.max(8, Math.floor((labelW - 12) / 6.4));
    function bar(idx, name, eal, share, p95, color, cat) {
      var y = padT + idx * rowH;
      var bw = Math.max(plotW * eal / maxE, 1.5);
      var bh = 16;
      var by = y + (rowH - bh) / 2;
      var lbl = el("text", { x: padL + labelW - 8, y: y + rowH / 2 + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: name.length > maxChars ? name.slice(0, maxChars - 1) + "…" : name }, svg);
      lbl.style.fill = "var(--ink-2)";
      var rad = Math.min(4, bw);
      el("path", {
        d: "M" + (padL + labelW) + "," + by +
           " L" + (padL + labelW + bw - rad) + "," + by +
           " Q" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + by + " " + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + rad) +
           " L" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + bh - rad) +
           " Q" + (padL + labelW + bw) + "," + (by + bh) + " " + (padL + labelW + bw - rad) + "," + (by + bh) +
           " L" + (padL + labelW) + "," + (by + bh) + " Z",
        style: "fill:" + color
      }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL + labelW + bw + 6, y: y + rowH / 2 + 3.5, "class": "dl-text", text: fmtMoney(eal) }, svg);
      var hit = el("rect", { x: 0, y: y, width: W, height: rowH, "class": "bar-hit", tabindex: 0,
        "aria-label": name + ": " + fmtMoney(eal) + " expected annual loss, " + fmtPct(share) }, svg);
      function show(evt) {
        var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
        var px = evt && evt.clientX ? evt.clientX - rect.left : padL + labelW + 40;
        var py = evt && evt.clientY ? evt.clientY - rect.top : y;
        var rowsData = [
          { value: fmtMoney(eal), label: "expected annual loss", color: color.indexOf("var(") === 0 ? getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue(color.slice(4, -1)) : color },
          { value: fmtPct(share), label: "of portfolio EAL" }
        ];
        if (p95 !== null && p95 !== undefined) {
          rowsData.push({ value: fmtMoney(p95), label: "P95 annual loss" });
        }
        tip.show(rowsData, px, py, cat ? name + " · " + cat : name);
      }
      hit.addEventListener("pointermove", show);
      hit.addEventListener("focus", function () { show(null); });
      hit.addEventListener("pointerleave", tip.hide);
      hit.addEventListener("blur", tip.hide);
    }

    shown.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      bar(idx, p.ref.name, p.eal, p.share, p.p95, catColor[p.ref.category] || "var(--demph)", p.ref.category);
    });
    if (rest.length > 0) {
      var restShare = r.per.reduce(function (a, p2) { return a + p2.share; }, 0);
      var shownShare = shown.reduce(function (a, p2) { return a + p2.share; }, 0);
      bar(shown.length, "Other (" + rest.length + " risks)", restSum, restShare - shownShare, null, "var(--demph)", "");
    }

    var tbl = byId("torTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Risk", "Entity", "EAL", "Share", "P95 annual loss"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    r.per.forEach(function (p) {
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.ref.name;
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.ref.category;
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(p.eal);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtPct(p.share);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = p.p95 !== null ? fmtMoneyFull(p.p95) : "—";
    });
  }

  // ---------- convergence ----------
  function renderConv(r) {
    var box = byId("convBox");
    clear(box);
    var W = Math.max(box.clientWidth, 280), H = 240;
    var padL = 52, padR = 60, padT = 12, padB = 30;
    var svg = el("svg", { width: W, height: H, viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H }, box);
    var tip = makeTip(box);
    var plotW = W - padL - padR, plotH = H - padT - padB;
    var conv = r.conv;
    if (conv.length < 2) { return; }
    var minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    var start = Math.min(4, conv.length - 1);
    for (var i = start; i < conv.length; i++) {
      if (conv[i][1] < minY) { minY = conv[i][1]; }
      if (conv[i][1] > maxY) { maxY = conv[i][1]; }
    }
    var padY = (maxY - minY) * 0.25 + 1;
    minY -= padY; maxY += padY;
    if (minY < 0) { minY = 0; }
    function xOf(t) { return padL + plotW * t / r.trials; }
    function yOf(v) { return padT + plotH * (1 - (v - minY) / (maxY - minY)); }

    niceTicks(minY, maxY, 4).forEach(function (t) {
      var y = yOf(t);
      if (y < padT || y > padT + plotH) { return; }
      el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: y, y2: y, stroke: "var(--grid)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);
      el("text", { x: padL - 6, y: y + 3.5, "text-anchor": "end", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtMoney(t) }, svg);
    });
    niceTicks(0, r.trials, 5).forEach(function (t) {
      if (t === 0) { return; }
      el("text", { x: xOf(t), y: H - 10, "text-anchor": "middle", "class": "axis-text", text: fmtInt(t) }, svg);
    });
    el("line", { x1: padL, x2: W - padR, y1: padT + plotH, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1 }, svg);

    var d = "";
    conv.forEach(function (p, idx) {
      d += (idx === 0 ? "M" : "L") + xOf(p[0]).toFixed(1) + "," + yOf(Math.min(Math.max(p[1], minY), maxY)).toFixed(1);
    });
    el("path", { d: d, style: "stroke:var(--series-1);fill:none", "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round" }, svg);
    var last = conv[conv.length - 1];
    el("circle", { cx: xOf(last[0]), cy: yOf(last[1]), r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2 }, svg);
    el("text", { x: xOf(last[0]) + 8, y: yOf(last[1]) + 3.5, "class": "dl-text", text: fmtMoney(last[1]) }, svg);

    var cross = el("line", { x1: 0, x2: 0, y1: padT, y2: padT + plotH, stroke: "var(--axisline)", "stroke-width": 1, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var dot = el("circle", { r: 4.5, style: "fill:var(--series-1);stroke:var(--surface-1)", "stroke-width": 2, opacity: 0 }, svg);
    var hover = el("rect", { x: padL, y: padT, width: plotW, height: plotH, fill: "transparent" }, svg);
    hover.addEventListener("pointermove", function (evt) {
      var rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
      var px = evt.clientX - rect.left;
      var t = (px - padL) / plotW * r.trials;
      var best = conv[0];
      for (var i2 = 0; i2 < conv.length; i2++) {
        if (Math.abs(conv[i2][0] - t) < Math.abs(best[0] - t)) { best = conv[i2]; }
      }
      cross.setAttribute("x1", xOf(best[0])); cross.setAttribute("x2", xOf(best[0])); cross.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      dot.setAttribute("cx", xOf(best[0])); dot.setAttribute("cy", yOf(best[1])); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 1);
      tip.show([
        { value: fmtMoney(best[1]), label: "running mean EAL", color: getComputedStyle(box.closest(".viz-root")).getPropertyValue("--series-1") }
      ], xOf(best[0]), evt.clientY - rect.top, "after " + fmtInt(best[0]) + " trials");
    });
    hover.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () {
      cross.setAttribute("opacity", 0); dot.setAttribute("opacity", 0); tip.hide();
    });

    var tbl = byId("convTable");
    clear(tbl);
    var t2 = hel("table", null, tbl);
    var tr = hel("tr", null, hel("thead", null, t2));
    ["Trials", "Running mean EAL"].forEach(function (h) { hel("th", null, tr).textContent = h; });
    var tb = hel("tbody", null, t2);
    var stride = Math.max(1, Math.floor(conv.length / 10));
    for (var i3 = 0; i3 < conv.length; i3 += stride) {
      var row = hel("tr", null, tb);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtInt(conv[i3][0]);
      hel("td", null, row).textContent = fmtMoneyFull(conv[i3][1]);
    }
  }

  // ---------- risk table ----------
  function renderRiskTable(r) {
    var body = byId("riskRows");
    clear(body);
    var byId2 = {};
    if (r) {
      r.per.forEach(function (p) { byId2[p.ref.sys_id || p.ref.name] = p; });
    }
    scenario.forEach(function (risk) {
      var row = hel("tr", risk.enabled ? null : "off", body);
      var tdOn = hel("td", null, row);
      var cb = document.createElement("input");
      cb.type = "checkbox"; cb.checked = risk.enabled;
      cb.addEventListener("change", function () { risk.enabled = cb.checked; scheduleRun(); });
      tdOn.appendChild(cb);
      var tdName = hel("td", "name", row);
      tdName.textContent = risk.name;
      tdName.title = (risk.number ? risk.number + " — " : "") + risk.name;
      var tdCat = hel("td", null, row);
      var dotSpan = hel("span", "catdot", tdCat);
      dotSpan.style.background = catColor[risk.category] || "var(--demph)";
      tdCat.appendChild(document.createTextNode(risk.category || "—"));

      [["fmin", 0.01], ["fml", 0.01], ["fmax", 0.01], ["imin", 1000], ["iml", 1000], ["imax", 1000]].forEach(function (f) {
        var td = hel("td", "num", row);
        var inp = document.createElement("input");
        inp.type = "number"; inp.min = "0"; inp.step = String(f[1]);
        inp.value = String(risk[f[0]]);
        inp.addEventListener("change", function () {
          var v = parseFloat(inp.value);
          if (!isFinite(v) || v < 0) { v = 0; inp.value = "0"; }
          risk[f[0]] = v;
          scheduleRun();
        });
        td.appendChild(inp);
      });

      var tdModel = hel("td", null, row);
      var sel = document.createElement("select");
      ["pert", "lognormal"].forEach(function (m) {
        var opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = m; opt.textContent = m;
        if (risk.model === m) { opt.selected = true; }
        sel.appendChild(opt);
      });
      sel.addEventListener("change", function () { risk.model = sel.value; scheduleRun(); });
      tdModel.appendChild(sel);

      var p = byId2[risk.sys_id || risk.name];
      hel("td", "num", row).textContent = risk.enabled && p ? fmtMoney(p.eal) : "—";
      hel("td", "num", row).textContent = risk.enabled && p ? fmtPct(p.share) : "—";
    });
  }

  // ---------- orchestration ----------
  var pendingTimer = null;
  function scheduleRun() {
    if (pendingTimer) { clearTimeout(pendingTimer); }
    pendingTimer = setTimeout(run, 450);
  }

  function renderAll(r) {
    renderTiles(r);
    renderHist(r);
    renderLec(r);
    renderTornado(r);
    renderConv(r);
    renderRiskTable(r);
    var stressed = freqMult !== 1 || sevMult !== 1;
    byId("mcFoot").textContent =
      "Source: " + dataSource + " · " + scenario.filter(function (x) { return x.enabled; }).length +
      " of " + scenario.length + " risks enabled · seed " + r.seed +
      (stressed ? " · stress freq ×" + freqMult.toFixed(2) + ", severity ×" + sevMult.toFixed(2) : "") +
      " · Engine: Poisson frequency × PERT/lognormal severity, seeded Mulberry32 RNG · " +
      "Generated " + DATA.generated_at + " from " + DATA.instance;
  }

  function run() {
    runSimulation(function (result) {
      lastResult = result;
      if (!baseline && freqMult === 1 && sevMult === 1) { baseline = result; }
      renderAll(result);
    });
  }

  // ---------- controls ----------
  function wireControls() {
    byId("trialSeg").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        byId("trialSeg").querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
        b.classList.add("on");
        trials = parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-trials"), 10);
        scheduleRun();
      });
    });
    byId("seedIn").addEventListener("change", function () {
      var v = parseInt(byId("seedIn").value, 10);
      seed = isFinite(v) ? v : 42;
      scheduleRun();
    });
    function wireStress(id, valId, setter) {
      byId(id).addEventListener("input", function () {
        var mult = Math.pow(2, parseFloat(byId(id).value));
        setter(mult);
        byId(valId).textContent = "×" + mult.toFixed(mult < 1 ? 2 : 1);
        scheduleRun();
      });
    }
    wireStress("freqStress", "freqStressVal", function (m) { freqMult = m; });
    wireStress("sevStress", "sevStressVal", function (m) { sevMult = m; });
    byId("runBtn").addEventListener("click", run);
    byId("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
      initScenario();
      freqMult = 1; sevMult = 1;
      byId("freqStress").value = "0"; byId("sevStress").value = "0";
      byId("freqStressVal").textContent = "×1.0"; byId("sevStressVal").textContent = "×1.0";
      baseline = null;
      run();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".tbl-toggle").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var t = byId(b.getAttribute("data-table"));
        var showing = t.classList.toggle("show");
        b.textContent = showing ? "Chart view" : "Table view";
      });
    });
    var resizeTimer = null;
    window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
      if (resizeTimer) { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); }
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (lastResult) { renderAll(lastResult); } }, 200);
    });
  }

  // ---------- optional live reload from the instance ----------
  function num(rec, name) {
    var v = rec[name];
    if (v && typeof v === "object") { v = v.value; }
    var f = parseFloat(v);
    return isFinite(f) && f > 0 ? f : null;
  }
  function disp(rec, name) {
    var v = rec[name];
    if (v && typeof v === "object") { return String(v.display_value || ""); }
    return v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v);
  }
  function mapLive(records) {
    var out = [];
    records.forEach(function (rec) {
      var fml = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_most_likely");
      var iml = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_most_likely");
      var model = "pert";
      var fmin, fmax, imin, imax;
      if (!fml || !iml) {
        var aro = num(rec, "residual_aro") || num(rec, "inherent_aro");
        var sle = num(rec, "residual_sle") || num(rec, "inherent_sle");
        if (!aro || !sle) { return; }
        fml = aro; fmin = aro; fmax = aro;
        iml = sle; imin = sle * 0.5; imax = sle * 2.5;
        model = "lognormal";
      } else {
        fmin = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_min") || fml;
        fmax = num(rec, "u_mc_freq_max") || fml;
        imin = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_min") || iml * 0.5;
        imax = num(rec, "u_mc_impact_max") || iml * 2.5;
      }
      out.push({
        sys_id: disp(rec, "sys_id") || (rec.sys_id && rec.sys_id.value) || rec.sys_id,
        number: disp(rec, "number"),
        name: disp(rec, "short_description") || disp(rec, "number") || "unnamed risk",
        category: disp(rec, "profile") || "uncategorized",
        freq_min: fmin, freq_ml: fml, freq_max: fmax,
        imp_min: imin, imp_ml: iml, imp_max: imax,
        model: model
      });
    });
    return out;
  }
  function tryLive() {
    var host = window.location.hostname || "";
    if (host.indexOf("service-now.com") === -1) { return; }
    var btn = byId("liveBtn");
    btn.style.display = "";
    function reload() {
      btn.disabled = true;
      var headers = { "Accept": "application/json" };
      if (window.g_ck) { headers["X-UserToken"] = window.g_ck; }
      fetch("/api/now/table/sn_risk_risk?sysparm_display_value=all&sysparm_limit=500", { headers: headers, credentials: "same-origin" })
        .then(function (resp) {
          if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
          return resp.json();
        })
        .then(function (json) {
          var mapped = mapLive(json.result || []);
          if (mapped.length === 0) { throw new Error("no readable risks (check GRC roles)"); }
          DATA.risks = mapped;
          dataSource = "live sn_risk_risk (" + mapped.length + " risks)";
          byId("mcMeta").textContent = mapped.length + " risks · live from this instance";
          initScenario();
          baseline = null;
          run();
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
          dataSource = "embedded snapshot (live fetch failed: " + err.message + ")";
          if (lastResult) { renderAll(lastResult); }
        })
        .then(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
    }
    btn.addEventListener("click", reload);
    reload();
  }

  // ---------- boot ----------
  function boot() {
    if (!DATA || !DATA.risks || DATA.risks.length === 0) {
      byId("mcMeta").textContent = "no risk data embedded";
      return;
    }
    dataSource = "embedded snapshot (" + DATA.risks.length + " risks)";
    byId("mcMeta").textContent = DATA.risks.length + " risks · snapshot " + DATA.generated_at;
    initScenario();
    wireControls();
    run();
    tryLive();
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  } else { boot(); }

</script>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description>three.js r147 (UMD) + postprocessing passes + the Netra Live 3D stage (glass orb, starfield, bloom). Loaded as a Service Portal widget dependency.</description><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_196061_netra_v1.netra_stage3d</name><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Netra Live - Gemini stage (light field). A near-black surface and two small light
 * fields, each one fragment shader at ~1/4 CSS resolution, scaled up by CSS: the orb
 * (flowing gradient light on the tap target; an opaque canvas carrying its own halo)
 * and Gemini Live's glow at the foot (repainted at 1/3 rate). On software GL the
 * compositor cost grows with canvas area, so the rest is a plain CSS background.
 * Canvas2D fallback without WebGL. Reads __netraState/__netraLevel/__netraBands.
 * API: window.NetraStage3D = { mount(host) -> bool, unmount(), fps() -> number }. ES5.
 */
window.NetraStage3D = (function () {
    'use strict';

    var root = null, O = null, G = null, host = null, sprites = null;
    var raf = 0, mq = null, reduced = false, onVis = null, onMq = null, onResize = null;
    var lastTs = 0, lastDraw = 0, fpsEma = 0, age = 0, winN = 0, slowN = 0, tier = 0, frameNo = 0;
    var cssW = 0, cssH = 0, measAt = -1e9, ox = 0, oy = 0, oR = 0;
    var lvF = 0, lvS = 0, bLo = 0, bHi = 0, errP = 0, lastSt = '';
    var tFlow = 3.7, shPh = 0, swPh = 0, brPh = 0;
    var KEYS = ['spd', 'warm', 'think', 'dim', 'gain', 'glowH', 'glowG', 'cool', 'talk', 'voice'];
    var P = {}, T = {};
    var OK = 1.8;   // orb canvas half-side, in orb radii (room for the halo)
    var GH = 0.4;   // glow canvas height, as a fraction of the stage height (capped at 820 px)
    var BG = '#0e0e10';
    // 2D sprites: blue deep/main/light, cyan, violet, rose, pale, (orb body), grey
    var COLS = [[26, 115, 232], [66, 133, 244], [138, 180, 248], [79, 195, 247], [155, 114, 203], [217, 101, 112], [200, 222, 255], null, [118, 128, 150]];

    var VS = 'attribute vec2 a;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(a,0.0,1.0);}';

        'const vec3 B0=vec3(.102,.451,.910);const vec3 B1=vec3(.259,.522,.957);const vec3 B2=vec3(.541,.706,.973);' +
        'const vec3 B3=vec3(.659,.780,.980);const vec3 CY=vec3(.31,.765,.969);const vec3 VL=vec3(.608,.447,.796);' +
        'const vec3 RL=vec3(.851,.396,.439);const vec3 BG=vec3(.0549,.0549,.0627);\n' +
        'vec4 outp(vec3 c,float dim,float err){float l=dot(c,vec3(.3,.59,.11));c=mix(c,vec3(l)*vec3(.9,.95,1.08),dim*.65);' +
        'c=mix(c,vec3(l*1.3,l*.62,l*.7),err*.7);float m=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b));' +

        'return vec4(c,clamp(m,0.0,1.0));}\n';

    // direction); time-only trig terms arrive as uniforms

        'uniform vec2 uR;uniform vec4 uA,uL,uS,uG,uP,uQ;',
        'void main(){',
        'vec2 q=(gl_FragCoord.xy/uR*2.0-1.0)*' + OK.toFixed(2) + ';float d=length(q);',
        'if(d>' + (OK * 0.99).toFixed(3) + '){gl_FragColor=vec4(BG,1.0);return;}',
        'float t=uA.x;vec2 n=q/max(d,1e-4);float c=n.x,s=n.y;',
        'float c2=c*c-s*s,s2=2.0*c*s,c3=c*(4.0*c*c-3.0),s3=s*(3.0-4.0*s*s);',
        'float r=uA.z*(1.0+uL.x)*(1.0+.015*(s3*uP.x+c3*uP.y)+.01*(s2*uP.w-c2*uP.z)+uL.z*.04*(s2*uP.z+c2*uP.w)+uL.w*.012*(s3*uP.z-c3*uP.w));',
        'float dn=d/r,h=max(dn-1.0,0.0);',
        'vec3 L=mix(B0,B1,.45)*(exp(-h*5.0)*.22+exp(-h*1.7)*.1)*smoothstep(.55,1.0,dn);',
        'if(dn<1.08){',
        // flowing light: sine domain warp, plus a fine octave on her high band
        ' vec2 w=q/r*.95;',
        ' w+=.5*vec2(sin(w.y*1.6+t*.61),sin(w.x*1.4-t*.53));',
        ' w+=.28*vec2(sin(w.y*2.7-t*.83+1.3),sin(w.x*2.4+t*.71+2.1));',
        ' if(uL.w>.01)w+=.2*uL.w*vec2(sin(w.y*5.3+uA.y),sin(w.x*4.9-uA.y*1.1));',
        ' float f1=.5+.5*sin(w.x*1.5+w.y*.9+t*.2),f2=.5+.5*sin(w.y*1.8-w.x*.7+1.9),f3=.5+.5*sin((w.x-w.y)*2.1+.7);',
        ' float e=sqrt(max(1.0-dn*dn,0.0)),body=1.0-smoothstep(.78,1.03,dn);',
        // the Gemini gradient (blue > violet > rose) turns slowly across the orb; warm light

        ' float wv=uS.x*smoothstep(.42,.84,gd),wr=uS.x*smoothstep(.8,1.14,gd);',
        ' vec3 oc=mix(B0,B1,smoothstep(.1,.9,f1));',
        ' oc=mix(oc,B2,smoothstep(.35,1.0,f2)*(.2+.55*e)*(1.0-.8*wv));',
        ' oc=mix(oc,CY,smoothstep(.4,1.0,f3)*uG.y*.75);',
        ' oc=mix(oc,VL,wv*.85);oc=mix(oc,RL,wr*.62);',
        ' vec2 cc=q/r-vec2(uA.w,.16+.12*uQ.x);',   // a luminous core wandering with the flow
        ' oc=mix(oc,vec3(.74,.84,.99),exp(-dot(cc,cc)*2.8)*(.26+.16*uL.y)*(1.0-.6*wv));',
        ' L+=oc*(.42+.5*e+.14*f2)*body;',
        ' vec3 rc=mix(B2,CY,uG.y*.6);rc=mix(rc,mix(VL,RL,.5+.5*dot(n,uQ.xy)),uS.x*.7);',   // soft rim light
        ' L+=rc*exp(-(dn-.92)*(dn-.92)*80.0)*.2;',
        ' float f6=f3*f3*f3;f6*=f6;L+=vec3(.8,.9,1.0)*f6*f6*body*(.02+.4*uL.w);',   // fine shimmer
        '}',
        'if(uS.y>.01){',   // thinking: a Gemini gradient arc sweeping around the orb
        ' float a1=.5+.5*dot(n,uG.zw),a2=1.0-a1;a1*=a1*a1;a1*=a1;a2*=a2*a2;a2*=a2;',
        ' vec3 sc=mix(B1,VL,.5+.5*dot(n,uQ.yx));sc=mix(sc,RL,a2*.7);',
        ' L+=(sc*(a1+.55*a2)*exp(-(dn-.92)*(dn-.92)*30.0)*.8+B2*a1*smoothstep(.15,.6,dn)*(1.0-smoothstep(.7,1.0,dn))*.12)*uS.y;',
        '}',
        'L*=uG.x*(1.0-smoothstep(' + (OK * 0.76).toFixed(3) + ',' + (OK * 0.99).toFixed(3) + ',d));',
        'vec4 o=outp(L,uS.z,uS.w);gl_FragColor=vec4(BG*(1.0-o.a)+o.rgb,1.0);}'
    ].join('\n');

    // Gemini Live's glow (stage-height units from the bottom): a blue cloud bank with
    // drifting plumes, a paler foot, violet/rose clouds while she speaks
    var FS_GLOW = HEAD + [
        'uniform vec2 uR;uniform vec4 uA,uG,uW;',
        'void main(){',
        'vec2 u=gl_FragCoord.xy/uR;float x=u.x,y=u.y*uA.y,t=uA.x;',
        'float n1=sin(x*2.9+t*.23)+.55*sin(x*6.1-t*.31+1.7)+.7*sin(x*1.5+t*.13+4.1);',
        'float n2=sin(x*2.3-t*.19+2.3)+.6*sin(x*4.7+t*.27+.4);',
        'float p1=x-uW.z,p2=x-uW.w;p1=exp(-p1*p1*18.0);p2=exp(-p2*p2*24.0);',
        'float hA=uG.x*(.8+.16*n1+.45*p1+.35*p2),hB=uG.x*.5*(1.0+.34*n2+.4*p1);',
        'float ya=y/hA,gA=exp(-ya*ya*(.55+.45*ya)),gB=exp(-y/hB);',
        'float bx=.55+.45*(.5+.5*sin(x*2.1-t*.15+n2*.6));',
        'vec3 cA=mix(B0,B1,.5+.5*sin(x*3.1+t*.11+n1*.5));',
        'vec3 cB=mix(mix(B2,B3,.5+.3*n2),CY,uG.z*(.5+.5*sin(x*4.3+t*.2+2.0)));',
        'vec3 L=cA*gA*.85*(.35+.65*bx)+cB*gB*gB*.62*bx;',
        'float pv=x-uW.x,pr=x-uW.y;pv=exp(-pv*pv*22.0);pr=exp(-pr*pr*28.0);',
        'L=mix(L,L*.6+(VL*pv*.7+RL*pr*.55)*gA,uG.w*max(pv,pr));',
        'L*=uG.y*(1.0-smoothstep(uA.y*.5,uA.y*.98,y));',
        'gl_FragColor=outp(L,uA.z,uA.w);}'
    ].join('\n');

    function num(v) { v = +v; return isFinite(v) ? v : 0; }
    function approach(cur, tgt, dt, att, rel) { return cur + (tgt - cur) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / (tgt > cur ? att : rel))); }

    function targets(st) {
        T.spd = 1; T.warm = 0.1; T.think = 0; T.dim = 0; T.gain = 0.9; T.glowH = 0.13; T.glowG = 0.62; T.cool = 0.3; T.talk = 1; T.voice = 0;
        if (st === 'thinking') { T.spd = 1.75; T.think = 1; T.warm = 0.18; T.glowH = 0.12; T.glowG = 0.55; T.cool = 0.15; T.talk = 0; }
        else if (st === 'speaking') { T.spd = 1.3; T.warm = 0.85; T.gain = 0.95; T.glowH = 0.14; T.glowG = 0.66; T.cool = 0.1; T.talk = 0; T.voice = 1; }
        else if (st === 'dormant') { T.spd = 0.3; T.dim = 1; T.gain = 0.4; T.glowH = 0.1; T.glowG = 0.2; T.cool = 0; T.warm = 0; T.talk = 0; }
        else if (st === 'boot') { T.gain = 0.6; T.glowG = 0.35; T.talk = 0; }
    }

    function css() {
        if (document.getElementById('ngs-css')) return;
        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.id = 'ngs-css';
        s.textContent = '.ngs-stage{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;overflow:hidden;background:' + BG + ';pointer-events:none;z-index:0}' +
            '.ngs-stage *{pointer-events:none}.ngs-stage .ngs-cv{position:absolute;display:block}';
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
    }

    // ---------- layers: a canvas with a WebGL program or a 2D context ----------
    function glProg(cv, fs, names, opaque) {
        var gl = null, o = { alpha: !opaque, premultipliedAlpha: true, antialias: false, depth: false, stencil: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: false, powerPreference: 'low-power' };
        try { gl = cv.getContext('webgl', o) || cv.getContext('experimental-webgl', o); } catch (e) { gl = null; }
        if (!gl) return null;
        function sh(type, src) { var s = gl.createShader(type); gl.shaderSource(s, src); gl.compileShader(s); return gl.getShaderParameter(s, gl.COMPILE_STATUS) ? s : null; }
        var v = sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VS), f = sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs), p = gl.createProgram(), U = {}, i;
        if (!v || !f) return null;
        gl.attachShader(p, v); gl.attachShader(p, f); gl.linkProgram(p);

        gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
        i = gl.getAttribLocation(p, 'a'); gl.enableVertexAttribArray(i); gl.vertexAttribPointer(i, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

    }

    function layer(place, fs, names, useGL, opaque) {
        var L = { cv: null, gl: null, U: null, c2: null, w: 0, h: 0, scale: 0.32, sig: -1 }, g;
        function fresh() {
            if (L.cv && L.cv.parentNode) L.cv.parentNode.removeChild(L.cv);
            L.cv = document.createElement('canvas'); L.cv.className = 'ngs-cv'; L.cv.style.cssText = place;

        g = useGL ? glProg(L.cv, fs, names, opaque) : null;

            try { L.c2 = L.cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: !opaque }); } catch (e) { L.c2 = null; }

        }

    }
    function size(L, w, h) {
        w = Math.max(16, Math.round(w)); h = Math.max(16, Math.round(h));
        if (w === L.w && h === L.h) return;

        if (L.gl) L.gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
    }

    // every ~500 ms and on resize; buffers are only touched when a size changes
    function measure(now) {
        measAt = now;
        var hr = host.getBoundingClientRect(), wrap = document.querySelector('.netra-stage-blob-wrap'), r = wrap && wrap.getBoundingClientRect(), box, R, half, s, x, y;
        cssW = hr.width || window.innerWidth || 1280; cssH = hr.height || window.innerHeight || 800;
        if (r && r.width > 10) { ox = r.left + r.width / 2 - hr.left; oy = r.top + r.height / 2 - hr.top; box = Math.min(r.width, r.height); }
        else { ox = cssW * 0.5; oy = cssH * 0.39; box = Math.min(cssW, cssH) * 0.58; }
        R = Math.round(0.36 * box); half = Math.round(OK * R);
        x = Math.round(ox - half) + 'px'; y = Math.round(oy - half) + 'px'; s = O.cv.style;
        if (R !== oR || s.left !== x || s.top !== y) { oR = R; s.left = x; s.top = y; s.width = s.height = 2 * half + 'px'; }
        x = Math.min(2 * half * O.scale * 0.8, 180); size(O, x, x);
        if (G) {   // the glow keeps its pixel height on tall screens: clear of the controls, less area to composite
            y = Math.round(GH * Math.min(cssH, 820)); if (G.cv.style.height !== y + 'px') G.cv.style.height = y + 'px';
            x = Math.min(cssW * G.scale * 0.6, 320); size(G, x, x * y / cssW);
        }
    }

    // ---------- WebGL draws (uniforms only, no allocations) ----------
    function drawOrb(swell) {
        var gl = O.gl, U = O.U, lift = lvS * (0.5 * P.talk + 0.4 * P.voice), p3 = tFlow * 0.7, p2 = tFlow * 1.3;
        gl.uniform2f(U.uR, O.w, O.h);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uA, tFlow, shPh, 1 + (reduced ? 0 : 0.022 * (1 - 0.5 * P.dim) * Math.sin(brPh)), 0.14 * Math.sin(tFlow * 0.31));
        gl.uniform4f(U.uL, swell, lvS, bLo * P.voice, bHi * P.voice);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uS, P.warm, P.think, P.dim, errP);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uG, P.gain * (1 + lift * 0.25) + (reduced ? 0 : 0.05 * P.think * Math.sin(brPh * 3.5)), P.cool + 0.5 * lvS * P.talk, Math.cos(swPh), Math.sin(swPh));
        gl.uniform4f(U.uP, Math.cos(p3), Math.sin(p3), Math.cos(p2), Math.sin(p2));
        gl.uniform4f(U.uQ, Math.cos(tFlow * 0.4), Math.sin(tFlow * 0.4), Math.cos(tFlow * 0.13 + 0.8), Math.sin(tFlow * 0.13 + 0.8));
        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
    }
    function drawGlow() {
        var gl = G.gl, U = G.U, lift = lvS * (0.55 * P.talk + 0.45 * P.voice);
        gl.uniform2f(U.uR, G.w, G.h);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uA, tFlow, GH, P.dim, errP);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uG, P.glowH + 0.08 * lift, P.glowG + 0.34 * lift, P.cool + 0.6 * lvS * P.talk, P.warm * P.voice + 0.25 * P.think);
        gl.uniform4f(U.uW, 0.24 + 0.08 * Math.sin(tFlow * 0.09), 0.78 + 0.07 * Math.sin(tFlow * 0.07 + 2), 0.3 + 0.22 * Math.sin(tFlow * 0.05), 0.72 + 0.2 * Math.sin(tFlow * 0.041 + 2));
        gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0); gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
    }

    // ---------- Canvas2D fallback: pre-rendered soft light sprites, added ----------
    function sprite(rgb) {
        var n = rgb ? 64 : 128, m = n / 2, s = document.createElement('canvas'), x, g, c, i, st;
        s.width = s.height = n; x = s.getContext('2d');
        if (!x) return s;
        g = x.createRadialGradient(m, m, 0, m, m, m);
        // orb body: light centre, blue, deep rim with a lighter edge; else a soft light
        st = rgb ? [0, 1, 0.35, 0.78, 0.62, 0.34, 0.82, 0.09, 1, 0] : [0, '112,162,246,1', 0.5, '60,125,240,1', 0.78, '26,115,232,.95', 0.88, '98,158,246,.75', 0.95, '26,115,232,.25', 1, '26,115,232,0'];
        c = rgb ? 'rgba(' + rgb.join(',') + ',' : 'rgba(';
        for (i = 0; i < st.length; i += 2) g.addColorStop(st[i], c + st[i + 1] + ')');
        x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, n, n);
        return s;
    }
    function makeSprites() {
        if (sprites) return;
        sprites = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < COLS.length; i++) sprites.push(sprite(COLS[i]));
    }
    function blot(c2, i, x, y, w, h, a) { if (a > 0.004) { c2.globalAlpha = a > 1 ? 1 : a; c2.drawImage(sprites[i], x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h); } }
    function orb2D(swell) {
        var c2 = O.c2, w = O.w, t = tFlow, cx = w / 2, cy = cx, R = w / (2 * OK) * (1 + swell) * (reduced ? 1 : 1 + 0.022 * Math.sin(brPh));
        var g = P.gain * (1 + 0.25 * lvS * (0.5 * P.talk + 0.4 * P.voice)), k = g * (1 - 0.6 * P.dim), wm = P.warm;
        c2.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; c2.globalAlpha = 1; c2.fillStyle = BG; c2.fillRect(0, 0, w, w);
        c2.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
        blot(c2, 0, cx, cy, R * 3.6, R * 3.6, 0.2 * k);
        blot(c2, 7, cx, cy, R * 2.12, R * 2.12, 0.74 * k);
        blot(c2, 8, cx, cy, R * 2.1, R * 2.1, 0.4 * g * P.dim);
        blot(c2, 2, cx + Math.cos(t * 0.5) * R * 0.32, cy + Math.sin(t * 0.43) * R * 0.3 - R * 0.1, R * 1.3, R * 1.3, 0.18 * k * (1 - 0.5 * wm));
        blot(c2, 3, cx + Math.cos(t * 0.37 + 2) * R * 0.34, cy + Math.sin(t * 0.51 + 2) * R * 0.32, R * 1.1, R * 1.1, 0.34 * k * (P.cool + 0.5 * lvS * P.talk));
        blot(c2, 4, cx - R * 0.3 + Math.cos(t * 0.41 + 4) * R * 0.2, cy + R * 0.25 + Math.sin(t * 0.33 + 4) * R * 0.15, R * 1.4, R * 1.4, 0.62 * k * wm);
        blot(c2, 5, cx + R * 0.35 + Math.cos(t * 0.29 + 1) * R * 0.15, cy - R * 0.35, R * 0.9, R * 0.9, 0.42 * k * wm);
        blot(c2, 6, cx + Math.sin(t * 0.31) * R * 0.14, cy - R * 0.16, R * 0.8, R * 0.8, 0.1 * k);
        if (P.think > 0.01) {
            blot(c2, 4, cx + Math.cos(swPh) * R * 0.9, cy - Math.sin(swPh) * R * 0.9, R * 0.75, R * 0.75, 0.55 * P.think);
            blot(c2, 2, cx - Math.cos(swPh) * R * 0.9, cy + Math.sin(swPh) * R * 0.9, R * 0.6, R * 0.6, 0.35 * P.think);
        }
        blot(c2, 5, cx, cy, R * 2.2, R * 2.2, 0.35 * errP);
    }
    function glow2D() {
        var c2 = G.c2, w = G.w, h = G.h, t = tFlow, lift = lvS * (0.55 * P.talk + 0.45 * P.voice), i, warm = P.warm * P.voice;
        var gh = (P.glowH + 0.08 * lift) / GH * h * 3.3, ga = (P.glowG + 0.34 * lift) * 0.5 * (1 - 0.6 * P.dim);
        c2.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over'; c2.globalAlpha = 1; c2.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        c2.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
        blot(c2, 0, w * 0.5, h, w * 1.5, gh * 0.9, ga * 0.7);
        for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) blot(c2, i & 1, w * (i + 0.5) / 6 + Math.sin(t * 0.2 + i * 1.9) * w * 0.06, h, w * 0.42, gh * (1 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 0.27 + i * 2.3)), ga * 0.7);
        blot(c2, 2, w * (0.5 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 0.11)), h, w * 1.2, gh * 0.55, ga * 0.6);
        blot(c2, 4, w * 0.24, h, w * 0.34, gh * 0.9, ga * 0.7 * warm);
        blot(c2, 5, w * 0.78, h, w * 0.3, gh * 0.75, ga * 0.55 * warm);
    }

    // ---------- frame ----------
    function frame(ts) {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        try { tick(ts); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function tick(ts) {
        var dt = lastTs ? (ts - lastTs) / 1000 : 0.016, i, k, st, lv, b, lo, hi, swell, sig, gap, dO = true, dG = true;
        lastTs = ts;
        dt = dt > 0.25 ? 0.25 : (dt < 0.001 ? 0.001 : dt);
        age += dt;
        // the glow's context starts on frame 1: GL start-up is split over two frames
        if (!G) { G = layer('left:0;top:auto;bottom:0;width:100%', FS_GLOW, ['uR', 'uA', 'uG', 'uW'], !!O.gl, false); measAt = -1e9; }
        if (ts - measAt > 500) measure(ts);

        st = window.__netraState || 'idle';
        if (st === 'error' && lastSt !== 'error') errP = 1;   // a brief rose tint, then calm
        lastSt = st;
        errP = errP > 0.001 ? errP * Math.exp(-dt / 1.4) : 0;
        targets(st);
        for (i = 0; i < KEYS.length; i++) { k = KEYS[i]; P[k] = approach(P[k], T[k], dt, 0.16, 0.16); }   // ~0.5 s crossfade

        lv = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, num(window.__netraLevel) / 100));
        if (st !== 'speaking' && st !== 'idle' && st !== 'awaiting' && st !== 'listening' && st !== 'error') lv = 0;
        b = window.__netraBands; lo = lv; hi = 0;
        if (b && b.length >= 24) {
            lo = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) lo += num(b[i]);
            for (i = 14; i < 24; i++) hi += num(b[i]);
            lo = Math.min(1, lo / 600); hi = Math.min(1, hi / 1000);
        }
        if (!lv) lo = hi = 0;
        lvF = approach(lvF, lv, dt, 0.07, 0.3);    // shape: fast attack, gentle release
        lvS = approach(lvS, lv, dt, 0.3, 0.75);    // large-area light: slow, never flashes at syllable rate
        bLo = approach(bLo, lo, dt, 0.06, 0.3);
        bHi = approach(bHi, hi, dt, 0.05, 0.25);
        swell = reduced ? 0 : (P.talk * 0.075 * lvF + P.voice * (0.07 * bLo + 0.05 * lvF));

        if (!reduced) {
            tFlow += dt * P.spd * 0.9; if (tFlow > 4000) tFlow -= 3600;
            shPh = (shPh + dt * (1.5 + 9 * bHi) * P.spd) % 6283.19;
            swPh = (swPh + dt * 2.6) % 6283.19;
            brPh = (brPh + dt * 1.2566 * (1 - 0.5 * P.dim)) % 6283.19;   // ~0.2 Hz breathing
            // adaptive: if most of 45 frames missed ~40 fps, repaint the slow glow less
            // often (never resize buffers here: a resize stalls software GL)
            if (age > 2) {
                if (dt > 0.025) slowN++;
                if (++winN >= 45) { if (slowN > 27 && tier < 2) tier++; winN = slowN = 0; }
            }
            k = tier ? 3 + tier : 3;
            i = 1;
            if (P.dim > 0.9) { i = 2; k = 6; }   // muted: barely moving, so half-rate saves the CPU
            frameNo++;
            dO = frameNo % i === 0;
            dG = frameNo % k === 1;
        } else {
            // calm: a composed still, redrawn only on visible change, at most ~8/s
            swPh = 0.9; tFlow = 20.5;
            sig = Math.round((lvS * 2 + P.gain + P.warm * 2 + P.think * 3 + P.dim * 4 + errP * 5 + P.cool) * 60) + O.w + G.w;
            dO = dG = sig !== O.sig && ts - lastDraw > 120;
            if (dO) O.sig = sig;
        }
        if (dO) {
            if (O.gl) drawOrb(swell); else if (O.c2) orb2D(swell);
            gap = (ts - lastDraw) / 1000; lastDraw = ts;   // fps() reports how often the orb really repaints
            if (gap > 0 && gap < 0.5) fpsEma = fpsEma ? fpsEma + (1 / gap - fpsEma) * 0.06 : 1 / gap;
        }
        if (dG) { if (G.gl) drawGlow(); else if (G.c2) glow2D(); }
    }

    function mount(el) {
        if (root) return true;
        if (!el) return false;
        try {
            host = el; css();
            reduced = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
            root = document.createElement('div'); root.className = 'ngs-stage'; root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            host.appendChild(root);
            targets(window.__netraState || 'boot');
            for (var i = 0; i < KEYS.length; i++) P[KEYS[i]] = T[KEYS[i]] * (KEYS[i] === 'gain' || KEYS[i] === 'glowG' ? 0.4 : 1);   // fade in
            O = layer('bottom:auto;right:auto', FS_ORB, ['uR', 'uA', 'uL', 'uS', 'uG', 'uP', 'uQ'], true, true);
            measure(performance.now());
            onVis = function () {
                if (document.hidden) { if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
                else if (!raf && root) { lastTs = 0; O.sig = -1; raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
            };
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
            onResize = function () { measAt = -1e9; O.sig = -1; };
            window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
            if (window.matchMedia) {
                mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
                onMq = function () { reduced = mq.matches; O.sig = -1; };
                if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', onMq); else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(onMq);
            }
            if (!document.hidden) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
            return true;   // even with no canvas at all the stage still paints the Gemini black
        } catch (e) {
            return !!(root && root.parentNode);
        }
    }

    function unmount() {
        try {
            if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
            raf = 0;
            if (onVis) document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVis);
            if (onResize) window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
            if (mq && onMq) { if (mq.removeEventListener) mq.removeEventListener('change', onMq); else if (mq.removeListener) mq.removeListener(onMq); }
            if (O && O.gl && O.gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')) O.gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context').loseContext();
            if (G && G.gl && G.gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')) G.gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context').loseContext();
            if (root && root.parentNode) root.parentNode.removeChild(root);
        } catch (e) {}
        root = O = G = sprites = host = null; onVis = onResize = onMq = mq = null;
        lastTs = lastDraw = fpsEma = age = winN = slowN = tier = oR = 0; measAt = -1e9; lastSt = '';
    }

    function fps() { return Math.round(fpsEma); }

    return { mount: mount, unmount: unmount, fps: fps };
})();
]]></script><script_name>netra_stage3d</script_name><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-11 08:08:39</sys_created_on><sys_id>5c4611c5938a4f10e3aef0aefaba10da</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_196061_netra_v1.netra_stage3d</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_5c4611c5938a4f10e3aef0aefaba10da</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 23:43:25</sys_updated_on><ui_type>0</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>
